116 chos 'byung mor bu'i phreng ba/pa gā ta rat+na da dhi/ rat+na raṇ+ḍa ka zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag bang gsum dang yul gzhan gyi gtsug lag khang yang mang po bsreg /de'i che rat+na da ṅgi zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang dgu thog yod pa'i steng khang gi glegs bam 'ga' zhig las chu rgyun chen po babs te me bsad/ chu rgyun khyab sar glegs bam rnams ma tshig /phyis glegs bam de rnams blangs te blta ba'i tshe rgyud sde bzhi'i glegs bam yin zer ba dang / kha cig gsang ba 'dus nga kho na yin zhes zer ba'ang yod/gang ltar yang bla med rgyud sde yin la de'i nang la gsang 'dus yod nges yin/ mu stegs byed de gnyis rgyal po'i chad pa ra 'jigs te byang phyogs ha pā mā zhes bya ba'i yul du bros kyang sdig pa'i las kyi mthus lus la me 'bar te shi/ 'di la spung po nyi ma'i dngos grub ces grags/ de nas dge slong mang du thos pa rnams 'dus/ sde snod blo la bzhugs pa thams cad yi ger spel/ rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs dang bram ze ba'i dang / bram ze phur bu dang / khyim bdag dad pa can mang pos lha khang rnams zhig gsos byas/ de la theg chen gyi sde snod sngon mi yul du byon pa rnams cha bco lngar btang na cha gonyes gnyis tsam re dam pa'i chos kyi dgra snga ma gnyis kyis nub cing / cha gcig tsam dgra'i gnod pa la ma ltos par yang nub pa dang /cha dgu tsam me'i dgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis nub pas da lda cha gcig tsam lus yod/ dper na dkon brtsegs 'dus pa stong phrag gcig bi nang nas bzhi bcu zhe dgu lus/ phal po che'i le'u stong be+e nang nas sum cu so brgyad
rgyan drug ma')ga b.lus/'dus pa chen gro'i dum bu stong gi nang nas dum bu da/gshegs pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'isnying wa'i le'u kho na 'a

21'phags pa thogs med/༄༅༅/ /shing rta chen po 'phags pa chodags med ni yum bram ze mo gsal ba'i ngang tshul ma'am sasal ba'i tshul khrims mar 'khrungs/ yum 'di ni sngon rgyal po gau ḍa 'phel byed kyi dus su dge slong sde stod bsum pa ba spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal malnga nga ba zhig yod pri des dbe chodang gzhan zhis dang brgal brtag byed pa 'e tshe khyed ni bud med kyi rig pa can no zhes smad pas na / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis lus 'dis khyodad bud med du skye/'on kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du ngas rjes su 'dzin no/ /zhes gsungs pa nyunig ci)na/bram ze mo 'di rgyal ༷/ sangs rgyas khyedags kyi dus tsam na byung zhing /chung ngu nas skye ba dran pa/ sde snod du ma mthong zhing thos pa tsam gyis khu+ong du chud/ spyan ras gzigs rtag tu mchod pa/ rgyal ba'i bsta na pa la smon lam gyi mthu grub pa/ zhig ste/ bstan pa la dgra byung ba ma bzod cing de spel nus pa bzhan yang med/ bdag kyang bud med du song bas mi nus na bu zhig bskyed la dar bar bzhus bo snyam ste rgyal rigs dang 'dus nga sa 'phags

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 119pa thogs med 'di nyid 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag tu lce rtser ghi hang gis a yig 'bri ba sogs rno ba'i 33 ga byas shing / cher skyes pa na rig gnas bco brgyad yum rang gis legs par bslabs te byang bar 'gyur ba'i dus zhig na/ bu des pha'i las dang rigs kyi cesas gang yin zhes zhus pas yum gyis rigs dang khyim skyong ba'i phyir bskyed pa min gyi/ bstan pa nyams pa ma bzod nas yin pas nga khyod rab tu byung ste rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar bar gyis thig ces bskul ba ltar mkhan po an+dha ta zhes pa'i drung rab tu byung nas mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa'i zhabs 'bring lo gcig mdzad/de nas bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga'i bar klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo la brtson te/ lo re rer tshigs bcad 'bum phrag re'i tshig don thams cad byang zhing chub par mdzad/ de ltar thun mong rgi sde snod gsum dang theg pa chen wa'i mdo sde phal cher rtogs sla yang sher phyin gyi sbas don mngon ho bas kyi rim nga yin tu rtogs dka' bar dgongs nas lhag pa'i lha bsgrub pri ra bya'o snyam sde/ slob dpon ar+bheta la sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhus pas me rtog rje btsun byams pa la phog /de nas ri bo bya rkang can gyi bras phug cig tu rje btsun byams pa bsgrubs te 'o/ gsum la ltas ci yang ma byung bas thugs skyo ste phyir thon pas/ brag gi ngos la bya'i chang bcas nga/ra bya phyi nang rgyu ba'i gshog pa reg pas brag zad pa gzigs nas nga'i brtson 'grus chung ngo snyam nas slar lngos ste lo gsum sngar bzhin bsgru bas /

120 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/yang ltas ma byung nas phyir lnga na pa'i lam bar chu thigs kyis brag zad pa gzigs nas yang sngar bzhin lo gsum bsgrubs pa las/ rtags ma byung bas sngar bzhin byas pa'i lam bar mi rgan sngo/ zhig gis ras bal 'jam pos lcags phyis bzhin kho bos khab byed kyin yod de/ sngar khab 'di dag byung ngo zhes zhus pas/ bya ba phal pa 'di lta bu la dka' ngal gyis 'di ltar grub na/ kho bos don chen po la brtson 'grus chung ngo snyam nas sngar bzhin 'o/ gsum bsgrubs/de ltar lo bcu gnyis song yang ltas ma byungabs thugs shin tu skyo ste thon nas phyin pas khyi mo ro stod mi la zug cing smad 'bus gang ba zhig gzigs nas snying rje lhag par skyes te/ 'bu 'di dag ma bsal na khyi 'di 'chi la bsal nas bor na 'bu 'chi bas/ rang gi lus kyi sha bcad nas 'bu 'di dag gso bar bya'o dgongs te/ grong khyer a tsan tur phebs te gser gyi spu gri g.yar te/ rang lus sha bcad/ lag pas blangs nas 'bu rnams shi bar dgongs te spyan btsum ste ljags kyis blangs pa na khyi mo med par rje btsun byams mgon mtshan dpe gsal bar mjal nas/ kye ma yab gcig bdag gi skyabs/ /ngal brgyas 'bad kyang 'bras ma mchis ci'i phyir char sprin rgya mtsho'i dpung / /gdung bas bsregs te skom ma 'bab/ /ces ngas de tsam bsgrubs kyang zhal mi ston pa thugs rje re chung zhes zhus te spyan chab bsil bas rje btsun gyis/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /zhes sogs gsungs te/ las kyi sgrib pas mthong ba min gyi nga rtag tu khyod kyi

rgyan drug mchog gnyis 1/gas/ 121drung du gnas bzhin pa yin/ sngar rig sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa dang da ltar snying rje chen pos rang sha bcad pa sa sdig sgrib dag ste mthong ba yin gsungs/ yid ches phyir nga phrag par 'khur la grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams la ston cig gsungs nga ltar/ bstan pas gzhan sus kyang ma mthong / chang 'tshong ma zhig gi khyi ro zhig 'khur bar mthong / de la'ang phyis longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung ba dang /yang dbul po khur skyel bas 'chos ba zhig gis zhabs mgo tsam mthong bas kyang ting nge 'dzin brnyes/ thun mong gi dngos grub lnga ba/ slob dpon gyis chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ khyed ci 'dod gsungs pa la theg pa chen po dar bar 'dod zhus pas/ 'o na nga'i gos kyi mthar 'jus chis gsungs pa/ ltar 'jus nas dga' ldan du slebs/ der mi lo lnga bcur bzhugs shing / de'ang mi lo phyed la lo re brtsis pas mi lo nyer lnga yin 'es bshad pa'ang mchis/ der rje btsun byams mgon las theg chen gyi chos gsan te tshig don thams cad thugs su chud/ byams ce)sa sde lnga gsan pa na don tshan re re gsan pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mi 'dra ba re re thob cing mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang / thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa brnyes/slar yang mi'i yul du byon/ma ga dha'i yul phyogs gcig be lu ba na zhes pa'i nags su gtsug las khang ba'engs te bzhugs nas 〈 ba ma tshul khrims can mang du thos pa thog mar brgyad dang de nas rim gyis 'phel te theg chen gyi bstan pa ches

122 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/cher rgyas shing slob ma de rnams kyang malnga na shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs la mnga' brnyes pa dang / mdo sde rgya mtshos pha rol tu son pa sha stag byung ste / gnas de la chos kyi myu gu'i dgon zhes grags/ der byams chos sde lnga yi ger bkod/ byams chos sde lnga ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ mdo sde rgyan/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed/ rgyud bla ma bcas lnga'o/ /slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ theg pa thun mong gi sdom/mngon pa kun btus/ theg chen gyi sdom theg bsdus te sdodam rnam gnyis dang / sa sde lnga sogs mdzad/ sa sde lnga ni/ sa'i dngos gzhi/ gzhi bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba/ rnam par gtan la bab pa bsdi/ ba bcas lha// /de nas nub phyogs dang nye ba grong khyer sa ga ri zhes pa/ra rgyal po zab motsware phyogs kyi s+t+rin bdag byas te phyogs bzhi'i dge slong thams cad 'dus/ der slob don gyi chos mang du bstan pas theg chen gyi rigs sad cing yum gyi don la ma khas pa stong phrag brgal ba byung nas/ lnge na theg chen gyi bstan pa la dgra byung bas rim par nyams pa'i dbang gis theg pri chen pe'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i dbe slong mdo snge 'don nga mang po yod kyang don shes nga/ ye nas med pa las/ slob dpon 'ode nyid thog mar byon cing slob mchog brgyad sogs kyis chos/ bstan pri sa theg chen gyi bstan pa slar yang dar 'es phyogs kun tu grags/ de'i tshe rgyal po zab ma'i phyogs kyis ther phyin kha ton rgyun mar mdzad cing / des bsams pri/ stob dadza/dan 'ode ni 'phags

rgyan drug mchos/ gnyis sku/gas/ 123pa yin zhing gzhan gyi sems kyang r+shas zer ba bden na bdag gis kyang 'di'i yon tan bsngags par bya yi gal te mi bden na skye bo rnams bslu bar byed pas skye bo'i tshogs su dma' dbab par bya'o zhes blon po dang / bram ze sogs skye bo lnga brgya tsam bgros/ pho brang rgi khyams su skye bo mang ro/'i dbus su slob dpon 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bsod snyom dang na bza' phun sum chorags pa dag phul te/ khrim gyi nang du ma he nag ngo la sa dkar gyis byugs pa sbas/ gser gyi bum pa zhig gi nang du mi gtsang ba sna tshogs blugs pa sbrang rtsis bkang ste ras kyis gasku gas pa lag tu chodags nas/ khyim 'di na ci sku da/ lag tu thogs pa 'di ci yin dris pas/ ji bzhin du gsungs/'di tsam ni lkog gyur shes pa chung ngu la'ang 'byung na/ sems shes sam mi shes snyam nas ser phyin gyi marotsware tshig la dri ba gsum/ don la dri ba gsum ste drug po yid kyis dris pas ji lta bzhin lan mdzad nas/ rang bzhin sasum bstan pa sogs / de dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos chung ngu re yang mdzad/de la tshig bi dri ba gsum ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba ming gang gi tshis bla dgas yin dris pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes lan btab pa 'di lung ma bstan gyi lta ba ma yin nam/ bya zhin tu 'u/sa che ba dpas chad lnga brgya yod pa 'es dper byas/ nga 'i lus che ba 'di don sang dang sbyor/ ri dang nags tshal gyi mtshan ma ma mthong na/ rgya mcho dang thas nye 'o 'es pa la/ mtshan ma ma malnga/nga ba'i

124 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/sa mchams gang la byed ces pa gsum yin pa las/ de'i lan dang sngo ni/nang stong pa nyid la dbongs pa dang / gnyis pa dge ba'i las stobs che ba dang / gsum pa ྅ ra lam chos mchog chen po skyes pa'i dus so zhes dang /sngo na la dri ba gsum ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes rdzas su yod dam med/ chos thams cad ngo thod nyid med par gsungs pas gang ngo bo nyid med nga/ de yang ngo bo nyid med dam/ stong pa nyid kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mi byed par bshad pa'i mi byed mkhan dang / mi byed rgyu'i stong pa nyid gang yin zhes pa la lan ni/ dang po kun rdzob tu rdzas su yod kyang don dam pa'i rig shes kyi ngor med ces pa dang / gnyis par ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgongs pas ngo bo nyid med nga nyid la slar yang ngo bo nyid yod med gnyis su 'byed/ gas/ma par/ stong pa nyid du byed mkhan gyi stong pa nyid ni stong nyid kyi rnam pa can gyi blo dang des byed tshul sngar yod phyis med pa'i tshul gnyis shar 'be/ga pa yin no zhes lan btab/der rgyal po skye wa'i tshogs thams cad dad pa lhag par 'phel nas theg chen gyi chos bzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / de re rer yang dge slong brgya brgya dang / dge bsnyen sogs dpag tu med pa 'chod bar mdzad/ gnas der gcung dbyig gnyen yang theg chen gyi bstan par bcug /de'i tshe lho tshudags yul kṛ ṣ+ka rā ja bram ze pā su nā zhes pas/ 'phags pri thogs med ces bya bas man na po byams pa las lung blangs te theg nga/ chen po slar ches dar bar byed do 'es thos nas/ 'khor lnga brgya tsam dang bcas dbus su 'ongs

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sku/gas/ 125nas/ gnas chen brgyad kyi mchod rten rnams mchodad/ khyodab dpon lho phyogs su 'byon par zhus pas/ der slob dpon 'khor nyi shu rtsalnga dang bram ze bcas lhan du phebs par brtsams pa na bram ze ma nad kyis mnar ba'i pho nya byung nas/de myur du slebs 'dod pa na slob dpon gyi yul de gnyis kyi bar zla ba gsum gyi lam thag yod kyang / nyi ma de nyid kyi phyi dror slob dpon 'khor bcas lto phyogs der byon pa dang / de bzhin nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas/ tshong dpon da na rak+ṣi tas spyan drangs nga 'i tshe yang / sa thag ring thob rgon gcig gis bgrod la/ kṛ rdzi rā dza dnga.a rgyan zhes pa/'i yul gnyis /ra yun ring bzhugs shing chos bstan pas skye bo thams cad theg chen dar bar mdzad cing / yul de gnyis la mchod rten brgya phrag re re dang lha khang nyi shu rtsalnga rtsalnga bzhengs/theg chen gyi chos gzhi re re btsugs/de bzhin du ma sa dhar yang mchod rten brgyad/ chos gzhi nyer lnga btsugs/ lan cis rgya gar mtha' 'khob sku nga khyer a yo dh+ya dang nye ba'i rgyal phran zhig la chos bstan nas bzhugs skabs / de dang nye bar gar log bi grong zhis yod pas/ des dmag drangs te slob dpon la mda' mtshon sna tshogs 'phangs kyang / thams cad rtul ltar song nas ci yang mi sanod cing mtshon cha yang dum bu brgyar chag /de thams cad lhag par dad de phyag byas nas song / sku che'i mjug tsam la nā lan+dha'i mkhan po mjad de lo bcu gnyis su nā lan+d+ra bskyangs te bsta ma nga 'i bangs ngo ma dzad/ mthar rgyal ngo 'i khab tū ṭi phyi bzod pa bsdus 'e ngasa' lda na du sabesas so/

22slob dpon dbyig gnyen/༄༄༄/ /mkhas mchog dbyis gnyen ni/ 'phags nga thogs med kyi yum bram ze ma gas/la ba'i tshul khrims de nyid kyis bram ze rig byed gsum dang ldan pri zhig dang 'dus nga las khye'u mtshan ldan zhig 'khrungs/ blo byed ba'i che ga byas shing / nar son nga na yi se ngang / rtsis dang / rig byed ba'i la sogs pa thun mong ba'i rig gnas rnams ༷/ma nyid kyis lesas par bslabs/ de nas yum gyis sras la bu khyod bskyed pa ni rigs spel ba sogs 'jig sher gyi bya ba'i phyir du ma yin gyi/ ṅghol ba'i bstan nga spel ba'i phyir bskyed pa yin pas rab tu byung ste sde sdod 'a/ sbyangs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar bar gyis shig /ces bskul ba lta ra nā lan+dhar rab tu byung nas theg dman gyi sde stodad gsum mtha' dag byang bar bslabs/da dung chodas mngon pa'i mtha' rtogs pri dang / sde pri bco brgyad kyi grub mtha' nges nga dang rigs pa'i ra rma rma tha' dag rtogs pri 'i phyir du kha che'i ྅/la du phebs nas// slob dngo na a bhi lta ṣa bha dra'am 'dun bzang si drung du sngon dgra bcom nga rnams kyis ma ngon pri sde bdun dang 'dul ba

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 127lung sde bzhi'i gnas rnams bsdus te gtan la phabs pa'i gzhung bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo gzhung 'bum phrag bcig longs pa dang / gzhan yang slob dpon 'dun bzang la mnga' ba'i sbe snod gsum gyi bshad srol mtha' dag la sbyangs nas mkhas pa'i/ phul du phyin nga ra gyur te/ kha che'i yul du chos mang du bstan cing rigs lam dar rgyas su mdzad/ de nas rgya gar du byon ri/'i tshe bdud sdig to can gyis 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel bar ma bzod nas chom kun pa dang sho gam bsrungs nga 'i sanod sbyin gyis yid bsgyur te de das gis lam b.ro du slob dpon gyi lha rten dang glegs bam la sogs nga yo byad thams cad 'phrags/yang glegs bam sogs gsar du ba'engs nas phebs pa/ra sngar bzhin lan gsum gyi bar 'phrog nga na slob dpri+o na gyi thugs la da glegs bam dang nor sogs med kyang / blo la yod pa sus kyang dbrog tu mi btub nga/sa yo byad sang yang med nga ra 'gro 'o dgongs nas phebs de gdod pa med pri ra nā lan+dhar byon/ der yang chos rgya cher ston cing bzhugs de'i tshe 'phabs nga thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga sogs sazigs pas theg chen thugs su ma chud cing / lha ga pri/'i lha la gsan pa thugs yid ma ches nas/ kye ma thogs med nasas su lo/ /bcu gnyis bar du ting 'dzin bsgrubs /ting 'dzin ma grub grang chen gyi/ /rgyab khal longs nga 'i grub mtha' brtsams/ /zhes theg chen gyi sang zag dang chos la skur ba btab nga/ gcen gyis gsan nas 'dul ba'i dus yin nga ra dgongs/ te/ bogs rnge/nga rang si slob ma gnyis sa bcu nga 'i

128 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/mdo dang / blo gros mi zad pa'i bstan pa'i mdo blor 'dzin du bcug nas gcung bi drung du song la srod dang tho rangs la thon cig ces mngags pa ltar mdo bton pa dbyig gnyen gyis gsan pa na/ sku da la mdo sde sa bcu pa bton pas theg chen 'di rgyu bzang ste/ 'bras bu kha g.yel ba 'dra dgongs/ tho rangs blo gros mi zad pa'i maXn bton pas rgyu 'bras gnyis ka bzang bar 'dug pa la ngas skur ba btab pa lce 'dis lan pas gcog gsungs nas spu gri 'tshol ba'i tshe lho ba ma de gnyis kyis ljags bcad pas sdig pa ga la dag /sgrib pa sbyang thabs gcen la mnga' bas der gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ 'phags pa chodags med kyi drung du byon/ sku mched gnyis chos kyi bathobe nga mdzad pa'i tshe dbyig gnyen spobs pa myur zhing / cadags med kyi blo bas pa mi myur yang lan bzang sngo byung bas rgyu mtshan dris pas bdag nas yi dam la dris nas lan 'debs pa yin gsungs/ gcung gis kyang yi dam gyi zhal sko na par zhus pas/ khyed kyis theg pa chen gro'i chos rgya cher 'od/ mdo sde mang po la 'grel pa gyis/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i sngags 'bum sdu/sa shig dang phyi ma mjal yong gsungs pas/des gcen la dad de theg pa chen wa'i mdo sde mtha' dag tshar gcig sasan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin bsgrubs te chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa brtsoms te skyes dang bcas pa 'dun bzang la bskur/ de'i slob ma rnams kyis lo grag zer gsum 'di rnams rang re'i grub mtha' la skur ba'o//zhes smras pa dang / slob dpon 'dun bzang gis bong snyu ma pri la shin tu mkhas

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 129pas tshig rgyan yin gsungs ring / shin tu mnyes nas 'di la rang 'grel zhig mdzod ces bskul ma mdzad pa lta ra slob dpo na 'dun bzang la phul bas ma rangs pa yin pa/ mkhyen nas ma dgyes te/ snyu da pa'i don du ma ga dhar byon pa la / chodab dpon dbyig gnyen gyis bal yul du byon/de nas khrodab dpon zhig la rnam rgyal mi dbang / phyag rdor gyi dbang dang gdams ngag gsan te gzungs sngags bzlas pas lhag pa'i lha de gnyis kyis zhal gzigs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo ma nga 14 thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ nyan thos kyi sde stod gsum la mdo lnga brgya dang sho lo ka 'bum phrag gsum yod par grags pa dang theg chen dbo na brtsegs dang / 'dus pa rin sngo che'i mdo/ yum 'bum pa sku/gas mdo lnga brgya/ gsang sngags kyi gzugs rgyud sde lnga brgya rnams lo re'i nang du lan re kha ton du mdzad de/ de yang lcags kyi gzhong ring til mar gyis bkang ba'i nang du zhusas nas nyin mtshan sbrel bar mdzad/ brgyad stong pa ni nyin re kha ton mdzad/de nas rje btsun gyi bka' pra ka ra ṇa ste rab tu byed pa sde brgyad dang /ga'an yang / thes bsdus kyi 'grel pa/ mdo sde 'i bum pa brgya nga / theg chen kyi chos brgya gsal ba'i bstan bcos tshigs su bcad pa bsdus nga / de'i rang 'grel dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rnam bshad/sku/na tan bdun brjod pa'i gtam/ tshul khrims kyi gtam/ cesags kyi btam/sangs rgyas dang chos dge 'dun gsum gyi rjes dran gyi 'grel pa gsum/ nasdong yon lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad nga/ gā ya so ri'i mdo 'grel/ mdo sde sa bcu

130 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/pa'i rnam bshad/ blo gros mi zad pa'i bstan po'i mdo'i rgya cher 'grel/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bshad pa/ mdo sde sa bcu pa'i 'grel pa/ nyi shu pa'i rang 'grel/ bzang spyod smon lam gyi 'grel pa sogs mdzad do//pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad ni/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa/ chos thams cad rnam rig tsam du ston pa sum cu pa'i rab byed/ phyi don 'gog pa nyi shu pa'i rab byed/ phung po lnga'i rab byed/ rnam bshad rigs pa/ las grub pa'i rab byed bcas sku// /de nas 'phags pa thogs med sku mya ngan las 'das pa 'i 'og tu nā lan+dhar mkhan po mjad/ theg chen gyi mdo sde mi 'dra ba'i chos mthun nyi shu re chag med gnang ba dang / mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa dang /bstan bcos brtsams pa la sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de dus 'jam gling gi che dgu tshang mas 'di'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bgo skal cadad cing ༷/gas kun tu byon nas bstan pa nyams pa gsos/ sngar yod rnams ches cher 'phel bar mdzad/ shar phyogs gī+o ri'i yul du phebs nas chos bstan pas lha rnams kyis gser gyi char phab pa mthun snang du byung bas thams cad dad pa 'phel te/ phyogs der rgyal bstan rgya cher spel/ chos gzhis kyang brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs/ o ḍi bi sar bram ze ma k+ṣi ka zhes nga/sa spyan drangs te ko der theg chen dge 'dun stong phrag bcu gnyis la zla ba gsum ring dus ston rgyas par byed/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi dus las kyang theg chen gyi 'chad

31slob dpon mchog gi sde/༄༅//slobadapon ma chog gi ༷'i ni rgyal bzlo bstan pa la rab tu snying /༵ snod /snamaXramakhas pa chen mdo sngi dang sle/khyad par sher na dan man rtags rgyan lardo 'byung ba ltar tharmi chan gya lam rnyings rdzags gsan nas sgrub pa la rtse gas/ bzhus/sa pas nga ba phul du na pa/skya bo mtha' yas par sher phyin gyi man ngag bstan cing masnga rgyan sbyar ba'i man ngag spel bar mdzad do//

32grub chen thi ru pa/༄༅༅/ /grub chen bi ru pa'am gnas brtan chos skyong ni/ shar phyogs za lha/ra rgyal rigs su 'khrungs/ rgyal srid dor nas nā lan+dha ra zhugs/ thos bsam lha ma gsum rgya cher mdzad nas mkhan ho/ rnam par rgyal ba'i lha'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs te paṇ+ḍi ta'i gtsug rgyan du gyur/ de nas dgon sde de'i mkhan sngo mdzad/ bde mchog gi sgrub pa yun ring mdzad kyang mchog gi dasngo sa grub lnga ba rgyu lta chodag /mtshan ltas legs pa tsam yang ma byung khar/ltas ngan pa 'ga' shas kyang byung bar brten sa ga zla ba'i tshes 22 nyin/phyag phreng de chab khang du dor nas/ da de ring nas ngas sgrub pa mi byed/ dge 'dun gyi sri zhu dang rtsod pa kho na bya'o zhes dam bca' mdzad/de'i dgong mo bdag med mas zhal/ dngos su gzigs nas rigs kyi bu/ khyed kyi bag med kyi spyod pa de rnams dor zhig /khyed kyi las smon gyi lha de nga yin/ khyed kyis sgrub pa sngar ltar lhur longs la/ dngos grub myur du thob bo zhes gsungs skabs/ de la thugs 'gyod chen ngo sa phreng ba blangs nas dri bzang gis chus bkrus/ mchodal bshags mdzad nas sgrub

rgyan drug mchog ga3)sa sogs/ 151pa sngar ltar mdzad pa'i sa zla'i tshes 23 dgong mo sa drug pa thob/ tshes 29 dgong mo sa dgu pa bcas thob nas lha mo bdag med ma lha bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyi dkyil 'khor mjal/ snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ma nyams par brten rtogs pa ches cher 'phel/ (tshad ma bzhi ni/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa kau byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa/ gdams ngag gi sa rga ma cadar ba/ mo/sa gus kyi bsam pa codrom pa bcas 11/)de nas grub pa brnyes nas sha chang sogs snu gas kyi rgyur 'khyer ba mthong skabs/ nā latshu'i grwa pa 'gas shes te khong gi gzim shag gi lha 'gram du nyan rna byed skabs kha cig gis bud med bcu gnyis dang mnyam du bzhugs pa mchodang / 'ga' zhig gis mar me bcu gnyis dang mnyam du sku/da pa ma10nga /de nas grwa pa tshos khong dbenan gyi mkhan 14 yin par brten ྅/na nas smra ma nus/de nas grub chen rang nyid kyi chos gos rnam gsum gtsug lag khang zhig tu phul nas/ chang khang dang smad 'chojang ma'i khang pa sogs su phebs nas nga ni ngan pacod zhes gsungs/ de nas nā lanā nas gnas dbyung gi 'khar rnga brdungs shing de dang lhan du rnga pa ṭa gī zhes pa rang sgra grags byung / (rnga 'di brdungs skabs nang du 'ong chog pa zhig yin 'dug)de nas wā rā ṇa sīr phebs dgongs kyis saṅgār nga nang nga/ yin pas khyed mi gtsang bar 'gyur nges na nga thongs shig gsungs skabs/ gaṅgā gyen du chod nas lam byung ba'i grub rtags/ ya mtshan che bar ba'en nā lan+dha pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis 'gyod pas chur sadan 'dren dang bzod gsol zhus te 'dir gtan du bzhugs dgos

152 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/zhes gsol ba 'debs par brten ngas bzod par bya'o/ /'on kyang 'dir mi sdod gsungs nasardza rā ṇa sī'i nags gseb tu sgren mor bzhugs skabs/nyi rlung gnyis kyis gdung bas sku mdog nag por song ba yul de'i rgyal po phri rol pa yin pa zhig gis thos nas/ deng sang nags gseb tu rnal 'byor pa de mu stegs pa zhig yin na de la 'tsho gos sogs sbyin dgos/ nang pa zhis yin tshe phar ma bskrad na gnod pa bskyal bar 'gyur zer nas/ rgyal po'i drung du 'bod par btang / der brtag dpyad byed skabs dbang phyug gi rtags mtshan gang yang med pas/ 'di lcags thag gis bsdam/sa nas saṅgār skyur cig zer ba ltar byas kyang lcags thag grol nas slar yang rgyal po'i drung du thengs mang po byung /des rgyal po 'jigs pa dang ngo mtshar skyes nas nang bstan la zhugs pa red/ de nas chang 'thung zhing rin med pas nyi ma sked la mnan te grub thob nyi ma 'dzin zhes grags la mthar de'i chang rin rgyal sngo sa stsal/de nas lam 'bras rdo je'i tshig rkang zhes pa de khong rang gi slob ma shar phyogs nag po pa zhes pa de'i ched du brtsams pa ste/ sa skya'i gsung ngas lam 'bras kyi mthar gtugs sa de yin/

shwakyi+o3ོdpal ldan chas grags/༄༅༅/ /dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa ni rgya gar lho phyogs yul skre ma la ya'am rgyal ba gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya bar yab bram ze'i rigs kyi mu stegs pa kun ranan+dan zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ chung dus nas basbra'i gnas dang / rig byed dang / sman dpyad/ brda sprod dang / mu stegs can gyi grub mtha' yongs rdzogs la mkhas par gyur/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'ga' re gzigs nga/sa/ rang gi ston nga skyon can dang / bstan bcos rnams mi 'thad nga/ dang / sangs rgyas dang dam nga/'i chodas ni de las bzlog par gzigs nas shin tu mos pa skyes te nang pa'i dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs su bsgyur bas/ bram ze rnams kyis gnas nas bskrad/yul dbus su byon te slob dpo/na chos skyong las rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum ngo mtha' dag mkhas pa ra sbya ngas/ mdo sde dang gzungs sngags bsdodams nga lnga brgya thugs nas 'don/ rtos ge'i bstan ba3)sa gzhan mang po nyan yang ma tshim nga ra/ phyogs glang si slob ma dbang phyug sde las tshad ma kun btus/ tshar bcig nyin nga sa slob dpri+o na dang mnyam nga ra gyur/ lan

15 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gnyis pa nyan pas phyogs glang dang mnyam par gyur/ gsum pa nyan pa na slob dpon dbang phyug sdes kyang phyogs glang gi dgongs pa ma longs par nor ba mkhyen nas dbang phyug sde nyid la zhus pas shin tu dgyes te khyed ni phyogs kyi glang 14 dang mnyam ste grub mtha' nor ba thams cad sun phyung la/ chad ma kun btus kyi 'grel pa yang gyis shig ces gsung gi gnang ba thob/ sngags kyi slob dpon ni grub chen ḍi gi ba las dbang bskur ba nod de/ lhag pa'i lha bsgrubs pas he ru gas zhal mngon sum du bstan te ci 'dod gsungs pa na/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba 'tshal so/ zhus pas ha ha rī gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur cing / der bstod pa rgyun chags kyang mdzad/ re zhig na mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad pa'i phyir gzhan gzhung gi gsang tshig slob par bzhed nas/ sprang wa'i cha lugs su brdzus nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la su mkhas dris pas der mkhas shos grezhon nu rol pa yin zer/ de'i tshe gzhon nu rol pa de rgyal po las mnga' thang chen po thob ste/ 'bras zhing dang / ba lang ma he sogs mang bas/ bran pho mo chig stong sogs yod pa la der bran pho lnga bcu dang / bran mo lnga bcu'i las slob dpon chos grags gcig pus grub pa na/ gzhon nu rol pa chung mar bcas pa/ shin tu dga' nas khyed la ci 'dod zer ba la/ grub mtha' nyan par 'tshal lo byas nga/sa slob ma'i grar btsud/ gsang tshig bu dang chung ma la ma sado/gas gzhan la mi ston par 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams kyang las kyi bya bas de'i bu dang chung ma mgu bar byas te/ de rnams la dris nga/sa shes/

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 155ji ltar 'grog tshul thams cad nyams 'og tu chud tshe/ bram ze nor la sred pas sku na ma byin na mi 'grigs dbo ngas nas/ rang gi gla dngul pa ṇa lnga brgya bram ze rnams la byin/ phyogs de'i gnod sbyin zhig las gser gyi dong rtse bdun stong blangs nas gzhon nu rol pa la byin/ de'i nub mo bros nas byon te ga der kā ka gu ha zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus chen po pho brang dang bcas pa zhig yod pa la rgyal po duḥm ri bu zhes bya yod pa'i sar sgo yig btab ste rtsod nga ra 'dod pa su sku da byas pas/ gzegs zan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa bram ze ka na gup+ta dang / gzhan yang mu stegs can lnga brgya tsam 'dus nas zla ba gsum gyi bar du ce da nas thams cad nang pa'i bstan par bcus /rgyal pos dbang bsgyur te/ de dag gi nang nas bram ze longs spu+od can lnga bcu tsam la nang pa'i chos gzhi re re 'dzugs su bcug go/gtam de gzhon nu rol pas thos nas/ rang nyid 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rtsod par 'ongs nas 'di skad du/ gal te nga rgyal na chos kyi grags pa sku da cig /chos kyi grags pa rgyal na bdag sku/da cig ces rgyal po la bslo ba na/ chodab dngo na gyis gal te gzhon nu rol pa rgyal na bdas mu stegs pri ra 'jug gam gso/da dam brdeg gam 'ching ba ni rgyal po nyid shes/ gal te bdag rgyal na bzhon nu rol ba bsad du mi 'tshal te/ nang par gzhug go zhes gsung nas rtsod pas/ gzhon nu rol pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dam bca' lnga brgya yod nga/ re re nas rig nga 'i rnam grangs brgya brgyas sun phyung / der grezhon nu rol nga sa kyang nang nga/ra mchod par byas ring

156 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ kyi 'khor lnga brgya po'ang nang pa'i bstan par rab tu byung / gzhan yang gcer bu ba ra ha pra ti dang spyod pa ba/ lha ka ra gu rgya dang / bram ze ku mā ra nan+da dang / mu stegs kyi rtsod pa'i khyu mchog ka ṇa dā ro tu sogs kyang sun phyung / slar yang dra ba mi'i yul du phebs nas/ 'di na kho bor rtsod nus pa su yod ces dril bsgrags pas/ mu stegs pa phal cher ni bros/ 'ga' zhig gis rtsod mi nus par khas bslangs te/ yul der sngon gyi chos gzhi nyams pa gasku/sa nas dben pa rnams su bsam gtan mdzad de bzhugs/skabs der nā lan+dhar paṃ ga ra ma tsa byas rtsod par byed do zhes 'phrin brdzangs/ de rnams kyis kyang sang phod bya'o zhes phyi dus btab nas chodas kyi grags pa lho phyogs nas spyan drangs/ de nas rtsod pa'i dus su babs pa dang sangs rgyas pa rnams dang / bram ze mu stegs can mtha' dag rgyal po rab gsal gyisardza ra khā+e sīr bsdus te rgyal po dpang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus su khong gnyis rtsod pa na/ paṃ sa ra na re/ gal te de rgyal na khyed rnams gaṅgār mchong ngam/ mu stegs la 'jug gdam nga gyis/ ci ste khyod rgyal na kho bo cag gaṅgār mchongs te 'chi'o zhes zer nas rtsod de shaṃ ka ra ā tsār+ya pham pa na de 'chi bar rtsom pa slob dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma nyan te/ kho rang gi slob ma bha ṇ+ḍa ā tsār+ya la khyod kyis mgo bregs 'di la rtsod de rgyal bar gyis shig /ma rgyal yang rung nga khyod kyi bur skyes nas 'di dang rtsod par bya'o ༄ra nas gaṅgār mchongs nas shi/ de'i slob ma mang po nang nga/ra btsud/ 'ga' zhig ni thag ring du bros/ de'i phyi lor bha ṇ+ḍa

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 157ā tsār+ya'i bur skyes/ bhaṇ+ḍa ā tsār+yas kyang lo gsum bsnyen pa btang / lo gsum nang 'gog byed kyi rigs pa bsam/ lo bdun pa ra bstan pa dang/nga du btsug nas rtsod pas/ de yang pham nas gaṅgār mchongs nas shi'o/ /de'i bu rgan pa bha ṭā ā tsār+ya gnyis pa dang / shaṃ ka ra ā tsār+ya'i skye ba dang / bram ze mang po shar phyogs thag ring por bros/ bram ze drang po'i blo can lnga brgya tsam bstan par rab tu byung / lnga brgya tsam dar+sha na mchog la skyabs su song /skabs der ma ga ba'i bram ze gang ba zhes dang / bcom brlag rgi bram ze gang ba bzang po gnyis mnga' thang longs spyod che ba/ rtog ser byang ba/dbyangs can ma dang khyab 'jug gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ de gnyis po sa kyang rtsod du 'ongs pa slob dpon gyis btul te nang pa/ra bcug /de gnyis kyis yul so sor chodas gzhi lnga bcu re btsugs/de nas ma ga dha dang nye ba drong ma tai ga'i nags su yun ring bzhugs te rig sngags mang po bsgrubs/ de nas 'thigs byed kyi ri tho'i khongs na rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa zhes grong 'bum phrag sum cu la dbang bsgyur ba longs spyod chin tu che ba de'i pho brang du gshegs pa na rgyal pos su yin dris pa'i tshe/ shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsan+d+ra bo 'i brjod pa rnam par das /snyan dngags dpa' bo las byung sdeb sbu+or mkhas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su/ /'es gsungs nga/sa chos kyi grags nga yi e pa shes te/ rgyal pos gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs shing der bzhusas nas/ tshad ma sde bdun gyi bsngan bcos kyang brtsams/ gal te chos kyi grags

158 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnams gonyed log yang na shi /cesas ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ /zhes pa'i ched brjod rgyal wa'i stod yig tu babend/(tshad ma snge bdun ni/ gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum ste rgyal pa 'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ cung zad bsdus pa tshad ma rnam nges/ shin tu bsdus pa tshad ma rigs thig sasum dang / 'phros sgo ya na las lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi ni/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtas pa// rtsod pa 'i rigs pa rgyu gzhan grub pa bcas so/)yul der rgyal bstan dar zhing dge slong khri tsam byung / chos gzhi yang lnga bcu tsam btsug /de'i tshe gzhung don la blo bsgrims pas tshod mar tig ta btab ste drangs kyang ma dgongs/ brtsams zin pa na rgyal sngo sa dris par/rgyal sngo khyod kyis chad pas gcad par bya ba'i mi 'ga' sku da na bo sa dkar sngo bsos/ gzhong pa snum gyis bkang ba lag tu bskur te cung zad cig pho zhing gos na gsod do byas nas ral gri thogs pa phyi bzhin du 'brangs pas pho brang la skor ba byed du bcus la/ pho brang gi mtha' kun na glu dang ro/la mo mkhan rtse ba 'og cig gsungs pa bzhin du byas mthar mi der dris na mi des glu gar sogs gang yang yod pa ma shes te/ de la sgrims pas so//gzhan yang ce da pa'i tshe ṅgol ba bcu tsam la lan dus gcig tu thebs par grags so/ /de brtsams zin pa na yul srol ltar paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la brim sa pas/ phal che bas ma shes/ 'ga' zhig gis shes na'ang phrag dog gi dbang bis mi legs so byas nas khyi'i ma/jug mar btags pas/ kyi ni la ma srang kun tu rgyu ba bzhin du nga'i bstan bcos kyang phyogs kun tu rgyas

rgyan drug macesag gnyis sogs/ 159par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhung bi mabo ra skye bo phal cher phal la chags shing zhes sku/gas sku/ sku/ ka gcig bcug/phyis slob dpon lha dbang blo dang shākya blo la sde bdun legs par bshad de rang 'grel gyi 'phros lha dbang blo la rtsom par bskul/ lha dbang blos 'grel pa lan cig brtsams te phul bas chur sbyangs/ yang brtsams pas mer bsregs/ slar yang brtsams te/ phal cher skel ba med nyid dang / /dus la'ang sdod pa med pa'i phyir/ /goms pa'i phyir ni mdor bsdus nas/ /dka' 'grel 'di ni 'dir byas so/ /zhes bris te phul bas 'aho/sa dang cirgag zur gyis mace na pa'i gnad rnams ma byung yang dngos bstan gyi don tsam byung 'dug gsungs nas bzhag /nga'i rigs pa 'di dpyis phyin pa sus kyang mi shes sku dalha ngas nas rnam 'grel mjug tu/ rgya masnur la ni chu cad bzhin du rang gi lus la thim zhing nub pa nyid du gyur zhes sku/gas kyi cirgags bcad 'di bcug/de nas mtha' 'khob kyi yul gu dzi ra thar byon nas/ bram ze dang mu stegs byed mang ngo nang bstan du bcus /go ta pū ri zhes bya ba'i lha bang bzhengs/ yul de'i mu stegs pa rnams kyis khra ba dasngo na gyi bzhugs khang la me sbar bas 'tshig pa na nam mkhar rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs nas dpag tshad gcig tsam gyi sa cha na sku da pa'i rgyal wa'i pho brang dang nye bar byon/ji zhig na baṃ ka ra ā tsar+ya slar yang skye ba blangs pa de snga ma las kyang blo sno zhing mkhas pa/ bum pri 'i sdeng du lnga dbang phyug lis lus yongs rdzogs

160 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba bstan pri zhig byung ba de lo bco lnga'am bcu drug lon pa'i tshe slob dpon dang rtsod 'dod nas wā rā ṇa sīr 'ongs/ rgyal po ma gī pya ṇi la bsgos shing dril bsgrags/ slob dpon yang lto phyogs nas spyan drangs/ bram ze lnga stong tsam dang / rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa yang 'dus/ sngar bzhin rtsod pas tshar bcad nas yang gaṅgār mchongs te shicedi//de nas bram ze mang po rab tu byung / 'ga' zhig gis dge bsnyen byas/ de'i tshe kha che'i yul na bram ze bi rgya sing ha/ de wa bi rgya ka ta/ de bamimeng ta zhes bya ba gsum khong gi drung du 'ongs nas drang pa'i sems kyis grub mthar brgal brtag mang du byas pas/ slob dngo/na gyis yang dag pa 'i rigs pa bstan nas de dag skyabs 'bo dang bslab pa 'i sanas la bkod/ de das chad ma sde bdun la shin tu mkhas par gyur nas/ kha che'i yul du 10nga nas chos grags kyi ring lugs spel ba byung / slob dpon slar yang lho khyodags su phebs te/ bstan pa nyams nga mtha' das gsos/ yal der rang sis bzhengs pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa tsam dang gzhan la bskul te bzhengs pri grangs las 'das/slob dpon 'dis bstan pa la bcug po'i dbe slong dang dge bsnyen bsdoms na 'bum du nye ba tsam yod/ phri bzhin rjes su 'brang ba ni lnga las lhas nga/ med/ sku tshe'i tha ma'i dus shig na/ yang sngar gyi paṃ ga ra ā tsār+ya de nyid r+bha ṇ+ḍa ā tsar+ya phyi ma'i bur skyes te sngon las kyang blo gros stobs che ba ga rang si lha mdun du 'ongs te mngon su/ma du ris nga/ slob nga/ res 'bar

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ 161lus su zhugs/ de sngon med pa'i rig pa brjod pa byung ste lo bcu gnyis lon pa tsam na dpal ldan chos la rtsod 'dod pa'i tshe/ der bram ze rnams kyis re zhig gzhan la rtsod dang chos grags ni pham nga/ra dka' 'o zhes smras kyang / des gal te chos grags las ma rgyal na don chung ngo zhes lho phyogs kyi rgyud du song nas/ bstan pa dpang du bzhag nas rtsod pas dpa la ldan chos grags rgyal te de nyid nang nga 'i bstan par bcug/bram ze de dge bsnyen gyi spyod pa la gnas pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan par mchod pa byung / de nas mthar yul /liṅkar gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing skye bo mang po/ chos la bkod nas sku mya ngan las 'das/ sku gdung dur khrod du bzhugs la bzhen pas me tog gi char dang dri bzang dang rol mos zhag bdun gyi bar du khyab pa byung / gdung thams cad bo nga bu gcig tu 'dres pa las rus pa'i rnam pa ye nas med pa byung / slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal sngo/ srong btsan sgam sngo/ gnyis dus mnyam du'o//

pon4spuṭakhan byebyen ྅ni ba sbyor6ོ5ོ/༄༄༄/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'cho'i 'o rgyus ni/ mkhan chen bo dhi sa ta ste byang chub se mas dang/'a shān+ta rak+ṣi ta/ bod sked du zhi ba srung ba'am zhi ba 'tsho 'es pa 'di rgya gang yar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/sa'on nu'i dus nas khyim gyi nyes dmis/sa gzigs nas rgyal sri da dor te mkhan po ye shes snying wa'i drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen pa ra rdzogs/ de jigang sa'i thams cad mo da par smra ba'i sdom rgyun bzung ste/ 'di'i lugs kyi 'dul ba dasas sgrub gnang gsum/ gyi bcas pa che phra mtha' dag thugs su chud/ nyes ltung phra mo sa/ kyang ma gos nga 'i tshul khrims rnam das la gnas/sde sdod sasum la sbyongs te zin tu mkhas pa ra gyur slob dpo na dul ba'i sde bste na nas mngon t+tobs rgyan dang zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa'i sand klu sgru ba kyis dasongs pri bzhin thugs su chud/zab nga/ dang rgya che ba bonyis ka ston nga 'i bsta na bcos dbu ma'i rgyan 'grer/ sgo dang bcas nga/ brtsams/ 'di'i sku che sdod smad bar gsum gyi slob ma'i nang nas 'gran zla dang bral/ ba ri slob dngo na seṅge bzang ngo dang / slob

rgyan drug mchodag gnyis sogs/ 163dpon ka ma la shī la gnyis yin/ dgung 'i dgu brgya lhag tsam gyi bar du bod du rgyal bstan 'dzugs pa 'i rten 'brel ma 'grig par sku tshe bsrings/bod du 'jam dbyangs mi'i rnam rol chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan sku 'khrungs nas ring sngo ma lon par yab gshegs/re zhig bdud blon rnams kyis dbang dang nus pas bstan pa dang bka' bstan mang por rma 'byin/ nam zhis na rgyal sngo/sa sba gsal snang la sku gas kha shas rgya nag tu rgyal ba'i bka' 'asnu la du btang ba ltar bka' mang po spyan drangs te/ rgyal po'i sku mdun du slebs kyang sdig blon rnams dbang che bas bka'i mtshan tsam yang 'don dbang me/da par re zhig de rnams brag tu sbas/ de nas rgyal sngo sa sba gsal snang dang gsang bo/sa byas te sasal snang nas rgya gar du phyin nas rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i don ston pa'i paci ta 'tshol rtsis dang / bdud blon rnams kyi mthong snang du mang yul skyid grong gi dpon du bskos te btang / de nas gsal snang rgya gar du phyin te rdo rje bdan dang / nā lan+d+rar mchod pa phul bas me tog gi char babs/ byang chub kyi ring las 'o ma'i rgyun babs ching dge cod zhes pa'i sgra 'od dang bcas byung / de nas sba bsal snang bal yul du byon pas bal ngo 'i rgyal wa'i mchod gnas mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho bzhugs sa skyid grong du spyan drangs/ bzhugs sanas su btsug la ga bang gnyis/ brtsigs/slob dpon la sems bskyed kyi gdam sa nga zhus nga/ra/ 'di zhu ba la yon dbos gsungs// saser dngul sogs/ rin po che dang / dar zab

164 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/snam gos sogs yo byad ci yod phul bas da dung phul cig gsungs/ da ni lus la bcings pa'i ska rags gcig las med zhus par de yang phul cig gsungs pa ltar phul/ sems bskyed zhus zin pa na/ slob dpon gyis 'bul ba tshang ma tshur gnang nas khyed dang nga gnyis skye ba 'di la ngo shes pa tsam ma yin/ skye ba du ma'i snga rol nas nga'i drung du sems bskyed pa'i sras kyi thub cad yin/ khyod kyi ming ni ye shes dbang watwan gsungs nas mgo la phyag gis byil byil mdzad/de nas gsal snang gis slob dpon la phyag byas te/ bod kyi rgyal ngo'i bla mar phebs dgos zhes gasku la bas bod yul ni nga'i gdul skal yin/bod kyi rgyal po dang khyod gnyis lhan cig da bar ma skyes pas/ ngas khyod gnyis skye ba dgu'i bar du mang yul da za hor gnyis su bsgugs nas bsdad pa yin/ da khyod gnyis kyang nar sku/na nas dus la bab par gda' bas ngas ྅/da kyi rgyal ྅6) mchod gnas byas la yul byan shar chu bo 'og te ta'i 'gram/ri has pu ri'i drung du brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig kyang bzhengs/ zhes gsungs nas slob dpon slar bal yul du gshegs/ gsal snang bod du 'ongs te rgyal po'i sku mdun du slebs nas dben sa zhig tu chos bya dgos pa dang / mkhas pa chen po shān+ta rak+ṣi ta'i sku yon dang / bod du 'byon pa'i 'al bzhes dang bka' mchid gnang tshul rnams zhib par zhus/ nged gnyis 'di ltar byas pa bdud chodan thodas shes na khyod srog dang bral ba dang don chen po las nyams

rgyan drug ma6)ga gnyis sogs/ 165par 'gyur bas khyed dben sa zhig tu gab nas sdod cig /ngas thabs bya'o gsungs nas gsal snang re zhig dben sar byol/de nas rgyal pos thabs mkhas du mas bdud blo na gyi bsam sbyor mtha' dag gshig ste chab srid chos bzhin skyong ba'i dus la bab pa na/ rgyal sngo sa chodan dze rnams la bka' stsal ba/ nga'i ya/ba mes rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsug pa de zhang ma zhang sogs sdig blon rnams kyis bshig /jo bo shākya mu ni yang mang yul skyid grong du spyugs 'dug pas/ de spyan drangs la nged rang rje blon 'bangs dang bcas pas chos byed na rung gsungs pa rgyal wa'i bka' bzhin blon 'bangs rnams bo/sa 'cham nas chos byed pa la rgya gar nas 'ongs pa'i rgyus can zhig dgos/ su sku da ces gleng ba na sba gsal snang mang yul nas 'ongs pa de rgyal gro'i spyan sngar dgug tu gsol zer ba bzhin bkus nas rgyal 11sa khyedad kyis rgya gar dang bal ༷/la nas chos la mkhas pri su yod/ spyan ngo ngas shig ces bsgo ba na gsal snang gis/ za hor rgyal gro'i sras dge slong shan+ta rak+ṣi ta zhes pa dam pa'i chos dang gtsug lag kun la mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa de da lta bal yul du mchis zhes gsol bas/ rgyal pos 'o na khyod bal yul du song la bal ngo'i rgyal por nga'i bka'i sgrom bu 'di phul te paṇ+ḍi ta de nges par spyan drongs par gyis shig /ces mngags pa lta ra des kyang bo dhi sa ta bod yul du spyan drangs nas rim gyis mang yul du phebs pa na/ bod nas rgyal po/sa phebs bas khang la nga 'gro sba ra dang gnyer stag chang ldo nga gzigs/ sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs gsum

166 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/btang ba 'byor/ de nas rim gyis phebs te rgyal wa'i pho brang du nye ba na/ gsal snang sngon la phyin nas rgyal po la phyag phul/ poṇ+ḍita byon sku/da pa'i so/ rgyus gasku la bas rgyal po dgyes te bkur sti mdzad pa na 'ang chodan dag gis/ rgya bal gyi mi ngan sngags mkhan mang bas sngon la rtog dpyod mdzad pa legs zer/ sang shi sku gas 'ga' zhig gis brtags kyang ā tsar+ya'i skad ma go de nas kha che ā nan ta la lo tsā ba〉〉la nas dris pas/ slob dasngo na gyi zhal nas ngas lha dkon mchodag mchodad/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas/ ga༄ḍa thodar sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig byed/ spyod pa legs so cog la ma bslabs pa med/ spyod pa/ ngan no cog la ma btang ba med ces gsungs/ blon wa re dag gis rgyal po lacas tsar+ya 'di spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa 'dus pas thugs cadags mi 'tshal zhes gasku/la nas 14 brang du spyan drangs/pho brang bi chab slor byon nga na/ rgyal pos gser phye bre gang phyag rten du phul nas phyag byas te byin rlabs zhus/ slo ba dpon gyis rgyal po chen dze / khyod kyis kho cad mkhyen nam gsungs pa sa/ rgyal pos slob dpon dang ྅ na chad zhal ma 'dzoms lags zhus pas/ khyodan sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la gtsus/ las khang bi rgyan bsrung ba'i byis nga gsum gyis bye ma'i masnu da rten byas te sgyu na lam la/ ma codangs pa na ngas pa'i ta dang / khyod kyis mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po dang / gsal snang nas brda sbyor gyi pho nya ba byas te mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams su dam pa 'i chos dar bar byed nga 'i smon lam btab nga/ mnyel lam gsungs/ rgyal ngo 'i 'al nas/ de lta ra lags

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sku/gas/ 167mod bdag sgom yun thung bas len zhes gsol/ de nas rgyal pos bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel bar gasku/la ba btab nas brtag pa la mkhas pa yin/ rgyal po khyod kyis mgo la thod bcing ba dang sbyar na stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam zhig /zhabs la lham gsol bas smad du mnga' ris lham tsam zhig la chodas khrims chags/ sta rags ma bcings pa dang sbyar na bar du rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul ba'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzugs thub gsungs/de nas slob dpon pho brang rlung 'tshubs su zla ba bzhir dge ba bcu dang / khams ba༄ brgyad rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chodas gsungs pas/ 11da kyi lha srin khros te 'phang thang chus 'khyer/ dmar po ri la thog rgyab/ mi nad phyugs nad byung bas bod 'bangs tshang mas ngo log nas 'di rnams kyis cho sa byas pas lan zer ba na/ rgyal 1/sa mkhan chen ྅/ ji satwa'i zhabs la dbu gtugs te bshum bzhin du cadad bsod nams dman pas nag lhu gas kyi mi ma yin rnams kyis bar chad 'di 'dra byas/ cadad mi rnams kyang 'di skad zer bas slob dpon re zhig bal yul du gshegs nas slar 'byon dgos zhes zhus/ slob dpon gyis pad+ma sam bha wa spyan drongs shig /de yis nag phyogs pa rnams thub par 'gyur ro 'es lung bstan nas bal yul du byon/ sngar sang shi rgya nag tu phebs stabs rgya'i ha shang zhig gis ma 'ongs pa na 'phags pa rta skad kyi sprul pa 'di 'dra zhig 'ong zhes 'dra 'bag byas pa dang / lung bstan rnams dran nas/ sba mang rje gsal snang sogs mi

168 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/lnga slob dpon pad+ma spyan 'dren du btang / slob dpon pad+mas kyang mkhyen te mang yul gung thang du byon pa dang mjal nas rim gyis lha srin gdug pa can rnams dam la 'dogs bzhin du drodan te/ has po rir phebs te btsan sngo dang mjal/ mal gro thur byon nas thodad kyi lha srin thams cad dam la btags/ mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa slar yang byon nas khong dang pad+ma saṃ bha wa gnyis kyis sa chog mdzad de o tān+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang btab ste/ mkhan hre ba rnam gnyis kyis rab gnas dang dus ston byas te de rjes rgya gar ba thams cad yod smra'i sde pa'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te/ bod la rab byung btub mi btub sad pa'i phyir ye shes dbang po la sogs mi bdun rab tu byung / de dag malngaran shes 11gas sku(na tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/bdun po ni rba ra 'am dpal dbyangs/ gsal snang / spa gre+or be+e 1ri tsa na/ ngal lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma rin chen ma〉〉ga /'khe/na klu'i dbang po srung / lam gsum rgyal ba byang chub ste bdun po 'di la sad mi mi bdun zer/ skabs der rgyal pos bod mi tshor 'o/ tsā mkhas pa yang yang du bslab tu bcug /rgya gar nas slob dasngo na shī ma la mi tra dang / slob da1/na sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs paṇ+ḍi ta mang du spyan drangs/ bka' bstan mtha' yas pa bsgyur zhing zhus dag yang yang mdzad/ de thams cad chos rgyal nyid kyi spyan lam du phab nas bsre bslad phra mo/ tsam yang med par mdzad/rgyal sngo/sa bod 'bangs la khrims bcas te/ bod kyi mnga' 'bangs thams

rgyan drug ma〉〉ga gnyis 17gas/ 169cad kyis dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du bya dbo sa pa dang / rab tu byung ba rnams la bla lhag tu gus par bya ba dang / chos byed rnams kyis kyang mkhan chen bo dhi sa ta'i srol 'dul ba'i bcas khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzhi bzung nas khyodad pa rnam par dag pa dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal ba'i dathodangs pa ji ltar bkral ba'i lta ba rnam par dag pa de kho na bzhin bya dgos pa'i bka' khrims bsgrags mthar mkhan chen 〉/ dhi satwa sku'i babo da pa bsdus pa la cadags pa na chos rgyal khri sku nga la da thodad du mu stegs pa ni mi 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyis su gyes te rtsod par 'gyur bas/ de dus rgya gar nas nga'i slob ma ka ma la shī la spyan drongs la rtsod pa byed du chug na/ chos phyogs su zhi bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan te zhi bar gshegs/de nas skabs shig na mkhan 46) lung bstan bzhin rgya nag hā shang lta ba 'o/ga pa 'dzin pa zhig byung nas lus ngag gi chos spyod dge ba byas pas sangs mi rgya/ byar med la gnas na sangs rgyas zer te/ snu sa byed phal cher chad lta la sbyor/ dpal dbyangs dang / sba t+na sogs nyung shas shig mkhan po bo dhi satwa'i lugs ltar byed pa lta spyod mi mthun nas rtsod pa la/btsan sngo sa mkhan chen gyi lugs bzhin gyis shig gsungs pas lha na mun pa khros te chu gri rnon po re bsrel zhing ston mun min pa yongs rdzogs gsod zer bas rgyal dze thugs ma bde nas/ ye shes dbang po 'thodad du btang bas lan gnyis su'ang mnyam bzhag las ma ldang bas ma phebs/ lan sasum par ma khug na pho nya ba khyod gsod do zhes bka' gnon te btang / ye shes

170 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/dbang po brag phug 'dom bcu gnyis nga/ dpyang thag la 'gro dgos pa zhig tu mnyam bzhag la bzhugs sku da pa der phyin te gshegs par zhu/ gal te ma gshegs na bdag gsod du 'ong bas lcebs zer bas byon te rgyal po la bdag dgug nas mi phan/ mkhan ngo'i zhal chems 'ode ltar med dam zhus pas rgyal po mnyel bsos te slob da10na ka ma la shī la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang /ye shes dbang lnga sa nga'i mnyam bzhag la bar chad ma byung na sangs rgyas byams pa ma 'byon gyi bar du bod 'dir bstan pa'i mthu yod pa la bar chad byung zhes zhus sku da skad/de nas 14 nya btang ba hā shang gis shes nas yum rgyas pa la lha/gas pa mdo sde zab mo rnams spyan drangs te bshad pa bslabs/ chos bya mi dgos nyal bas chodag ces rdo na pa'i bstan ba〉〉sa bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo/ de la ce da pa thodang ba bsam gtan gyi lon dang yang lon/ de rigs pas bsgrubs pa lta ba'i rgyab sha lung gis bsgrubs pa masnga sde brgyad cu khungs la sogs pa byas/mdo sde dgongs 'grel ni rang gi lta spyod dang 'gal bar mthong nas rtog pas gril 'o/// de nas ka ma la shī la byon pa dang / rgyal sngo gung la bzhugs/ hā shang g.yas gral du byas/ cadab dasngo na g.yon gral du byas te rtsen min pa rnams de'i mjug tu 'thud/ btsan pos gnyis ga'i lag tu me tog phreng ba re gtad de khyed gnyis rtsod pa gyis la gang rgyal ba la pham pas me tog phreng ba phul cigapham pa de 'dir ma sdod cig bka' stsal te/ de gnyis rtsod pas slob dpon gyis yang dag po'i rigs lam nyid kyis hā shang 'khor bcas lan med du gyur/

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogres/ 171de nas sba ye shes dbang pos kyang cig car dang rim 'jug zer ba yang dpyod dgos te/ rim gyis 'jug na rgyu ma mchis pas de dang mi 'dra/ cig car 'jug na khyed da rung ci byed/ dang po nas sangs rgyas na cis nyes de bas ri la 'dzegs pa'ang gom pa re res 'dzeg dgos te/ gom pa gcig gis bgrod mi nus pa ltar/ sa dang po thob pa'ang dka' na/ thams cad mkhyen pa lda ci smos/ nged tsen min gyi lugs kyi gsung rab kun la shes rab gsum gyis sbyangs pas don nor bar shes/ chos spyod bcu la bslabs te bsgoms pa/sa bzod pa thob/ sa dang po skyon med pa la zhugs te sa bcu rim gyis sbyangs pri sa tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ khyod ltar na 〉rgags ma rdzogs blo ma sbyangs pri/ra'ajig rten gyi bya ba yang mi shes na shes bya thams cad ji ltar shes/ci yang ma byas nga/ra nyal bas kyang mi sku/nga bar shodags te 'chi na sangs rgyas ga la 'grub/ ma brtags ma dpyad par gom pa yang 'tshol na chos ga la swā gas 'es pa sogs rgyas par smras pas/ ston mun pas lan smra bar ma nus te me tog phreng ba slo ba dpon la phul te pham pa khas blangs so//de'i tshe co rma rma la sogs pa mya ngan skyes te rang gi pho mtshan rdos brdungs nas shi zhes grags/ de nas rgyal pos da phyin chad lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs bzung/ spyod pa/ chos spyod bcu dang phar phyin drug la slobs / ston mun gyi lugs byed mi rung ngo zhes bkas bcad de hā shang rgya yu/la du brdzangs /de ltar byas pa'i dpe rnams bsdus te gter du sbas/ rgyal pos slob dngo na ka ma la shī lar/ 'oder bstan pa 'a/ dag ther mdzad pa bka' drin che zhing

172 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/de ltar phyis rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du yi ger 'khod pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar ka ma la shī las dbu ma sgom rim gsum mdzad/ slar yang rgyal sngo/sa klu sgrub kyi lta ba mthar thug pa rigs pas gsal bar mdzad pa'i bstan bathe sa shig brtsam dbo sa par bskul nas dbu ma snang ba yang mdzad pa yin/

35slob dpon seṅge bzang po/༄yi/ /slob dpon hazabhadra'am seṅge bzang po ni sngon gyi thugs bskyed ltar rgyal rigs su sku 'khrungs/ slob dpo/na 'di ma'i mngal na gnas pa'i tshe ma la seṅges gnod pa/ byung ste ma'i lus seng ges zos nas kyang khye'u ma zos par bde bar skyes pas seng ge bzang po zhes btags/ nar sku/na pa na khyim gyi 'du 'dzi la ma chags pa ra rab tu byung ste dge slong gi sdom pa ba'es/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' thams cad la sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/de nas sher mdo'i don 'ba' zhig 'tshol ba lhur blangs pa de'i tshe mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho bsam khyodar gnyis kyi tshul bzhin du bsten te/ rje btsun byams pa'i sher phyin gyi man ngag 'phags pa thogs med sku mched/'phags pa grol sde'i gzhung rnams dang klu sgru ba kyis bkral ba'i dbu ma'i gzhung rnams la'ang zhib tu sbya ngas / theg pa gsum sha'i lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs la myong ba khyad pa/ra du 'phags pa 'khrungs te skal ldan stong phrag du ma la sher phyin 'angoms par mdzad/ da dung bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad bzhed nas/ malan chen zhi ba 'tsho la byams pri ci) sgrub thabs zhus nas

174 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/bsgrubs pas sma lam du dge slong gur kum mdog can spyod lam mjes pa zhig rmis te/ des shar phyogres kha sarlu ṇir song shig /ces lung bstan pa ltar drodan nas zhag gsum du smyung gnas byas te gli lam brtags pri sa tho rangs kyi sma lam na o tān+ta pū ri hā ta'i gan dho la'i steng gi nam mkha' la sprin phung mthug po zhig gi gseb na lha'i lus kyi stod cha thon nas mchod nga/ mthong / ci byed dris pas/ rje btsun byams mgon brgyad stong pa gsungs rngu la mchod pa yin zer/ ring du bltas nga sa rje btsun zhal gser mdog can spyi gtsug mace)da rten gyis spras pa phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa zhig mjal nas phyag dang mchod pa byas te/ khyed kyi bstan ba༄ sa la deng sang 'grel pa mang po zhig 'dug na gang gi rjes su 'jug dgos zhus pas thams cad kyi bzhung gi 'thad pa bsdus te khyed kyis bstan bcos rtsoms rig ces gnang ba thob/ mnal sad de bstan bathodas rtsom pa'i sbyin bdag 'tshol bar shar ༷ gas nas nub tu byon pa na/ rgyal po dharma pā las slob dpon seng be bzang sngo/ yum 'chad pa la mkhas zhes thos nas gdan 'dren pa btang ba'i pho nya dang 'phrad nas lhan du byon te tsha ba gsum gsum gyi gtsung lag khang du phebs/ dge 'dun stong phrag mang po la sher phyin gyi man ngag rgya cher bstan/rgyal sngo dharma pā las sbyin bdag dang byams mason gyi lung bstan ltar mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal dang / mngon rtogs rgyan dang brgyad stong pa sbyar ba'i man ngag brgyad stong 'grel chen dang / nyi khri

rgyan drug ma chog gnyis sobs/ 175snang ba dang mthun par nyi khri'i bsdus don le'u brgyad ma dang mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa rtogs sla/ sher phyin sgom nga / tsan+d+ra pa'i rnam dbye'i tshig le'ur byas pa rnams mdzad/ de'i nang nas 'grel pa don gsal ni sher phyin gyi ma do sde blta ba'i mig lta bur gyur pa yin no//

36rgyal sras zhi ba lha /༄༅༅/ /rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha ni lda je gdan gyi nub phyogs yul 'khor mo bzang 'es par yab rgyal nge dge ba'i go cha dang yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mar grags pa zhig gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ mtshan zhi ba'i so cha zhes gresol/chung ngu nas rig gnas thams cad la mkhas/dgung lo drug lon pa'i tshe grub thob zhig dang mjal te 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dbang sgrub thabs zhus nas basbedams pas 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs/ sadams pa mang du bstan/ yab rgyal po 'das nas rgyal srid 'di nyid rgyal po'i khrir sang nyin mnga' gsol rgyu'i do nub rmi lam na/'jam dpal gyis khrir bzhugs nas/ bu gcig 'di ni nga yi stan yin te//nga ni khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /khyod dang nga gnyis stan gcig la 'dug nga// /'di ni rnam pa kun tu rigs ma yin/ /'es gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du rje btsun sgrol mas ma yi tshul bzung nas khrus kyi phyir chu tshan spyi bo nas blugs/ te/ bu rgyal srid ri dmyal ba'i chu chan nyid de/des khyod la dbang bskur bar nye'o/ /'es gsungs/ nga bcas/ gnyid sad

rgyan drug ma1)ga gnyis sogs/ 17pa na rgyal srid ni dug gi sdong po dang mtshungs so snyam du dgongs nas bros te phebs/ zhag nyi shu rtsagacig phrin pa na nyo ma tshad kyis gdungs te nags kyi rtsaba'i chu mig zhig 'thung bar brtsams pas glo bur du bu mo zhig 'ong nas 'di ni dug chu ste btung mi rigs gsungs te chu zhim po blud cing nags kyi phug na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug pa'i drung du 'khrid/ de ni 'jam dpal dbyangs dang sa mkhan 'di ni rje btsun stsodal ma yin/ rnal 'khyodar pas dbang bskur bas ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes kyi sgo dpag tu med pa brnyes/de nas yi dam gyi phyag mtshan shing gi ral gri shubs dang bcas pa gcig bsnams nas rgyu ba la/ rgyal cad seng ge lnga pa'i 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/der sgyu rtsal la mkhas shing blo gros che bas blon po gyis gsungs pa ltar re zhig zhal gyis bzhes/ der bacho jo'i gnas thams cad dar bar mdzad cing / rgyal srid chos bzhin khyodang bcug pas/ blon po gzhan zhig gis phrag dog byas te/rgyal po la 'di ni g.yo can zhig ste/ ral gri yang shing las med do zhes zhus pa na rgyal po blon po thams cad kyi ral gri 'don dgos gsungs/ slob dpon gyis 'di phyungs na rgyal wa 3da la gnod par 'gyur ro zhus par lhag par the tshom ste gnod kyang bla yi nges par ston cig zer/ 'o na spyan g.yas pa btsum la g.yon pas gzigs shig ces gsungs pa ltar byas nas bstan pas ral gri'i 'od kyis rgyal po mig g.yon pa sa la lhung / slar mig 'brul ba 'byar bar mdzad pas lhag par dad pa skyes/ des grub thob yin par shes te/ rnyed bkur mang po byas nas bzhugs su gsol bas/ rgyal srid chos bzhin gyis la/ nang

178 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/pa 'e chos gzhi nyi shu tshugs zhes basbos natra/ yul dbus su byon/ dpal nā lan+dhar mkhan sngo/ rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung / mtshan zhi nge'i lhar zhes btags/rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs las yun ring du chos gsan te/ mdo sngags kyi gnad ma lus pa thugs su chud/ phyi nang gi g.yeng ba thams cad bcad de nang du yang dag 'jog gi lam masngo na sngo ra byon/thun mong ba'i snang ngor nyin re bzhin 'bras bre bo che lnga lnga gsol/klogre pa thos bsam dang sgyu nga ba bsam gtan gang yang ma byas pa ltar mthong nas/ byu su ku zhes pa ste 'du thes gsum pa ba zhes btags/ de nas dus shig na macadan shes med pa'i rab byung rnams kyis rab byung thi bya ba ni 'kho ra lo gsum gyi bya ba yin na 'dis gang yang mi byed pas dad rdzas chud gzon pas bskrad dgos/ de ya nga mdo 'don res byas pas rang bud 'gro'o snyam nas masnga 'don nga ra balha sa pas thog mar zhal gyis ma bzhes/ slar yang nan gyis zhus pa la co/ na khri rtsigs shig gasnga na par bya'o gsungs pa la 'ga' zhig the tshom skyes/brnyas smod byed pa de dag gis dge 'dun 'dus pa/'i dbus/ skas med pashin khri ha cang mthon po bshams pa na/ 'dis phyag gis cung zad mnan nas steng du thogs pa med par phebs/ de nas ngas sngon chad grags pa'i mdo zhig 'asnga na nam/ ma grags pa zhig 'asnga na zhes bka' stsal pas/ sngon chad ma grags pa/ zhig gsungs par zhu zhus pas/ bde gathegs chodas kyi sku mnga' sras bcas dang / /phyag 'os kun la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal te/

rgyan drug mchog gnyis sku/gas/ 179/zhes sogs spu+od 'jug gsungs nas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngosdo/ med dgaces pa'i mtshams rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'phags te je mtho je mthor nam mkha' dang mkhyen rab 'gran pa bzhin du gshegs nas mthar sku ma mthong yang gsung grags pa'i sbo nas rdzogs par bton te gshegs/ de'i shul du rna ba'i mngon shes can dang / mi brjed pa'i gzungs la dbang 'byor ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis gzhung btus pa na/ kha che ba rnams la sna 'o/ ka stong lhag pa cig byung / mchod brjod rang rgi blos sbyar/ yul shar pa rnams sho lo ka bdun brgya las ma byung ba/ bshags pa'i le'u dang shes rab kyi le'u chad par grags/ dbus pa ba rnams la rjes bsngags kyi dbang du byas nas brtsis na sho lo ka stong yod pa byung bas/ tshang mas the tshom du gyur/ de rjes tri liṅga'i cha grong khyer ka liṅkar bzhugs/ zhes thos pa ltar paṇ+ḍita gsum gyis song nas na nā lasprar 'byon par zhus kyang zhal bzhes ma gnang / rang rang gis mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyis yi ger bkod pa las dag pa gang yin zhus pas/ yul dbus pa rnams kyis bzung ba ltar yin gsungs/cod na bslab pa kun las btus dang / mdo kun las btus pa blta bar gsungs pa gang yin zhus pas/ brang khang gi skar khung na shing shun la panyi ta'i yi ge phra mos bris nas yod/ de las longs gsungs te/ de gnyis kyi man ngag rdzogs par gnang / de nas nags tshal dang bcas pri 'i gtsug lag khang zhig tu dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig bzhugs pa las/ slob dngo na gyi sgrub khang du ri dgas ji tsam song yang phyir thon pa ma mthong nas/

180 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/dge dzā nga rnams kyis ri dgas bsad par dogs te rgol bar brtsams pa na / ri dgas rnams slar gsos te nyams stobs dang ldan pa nags su sku/nga bas malnga/la bshags phul te/ bzhugs par gsol yang ma bzhugs shing rab byung gi rtags kyang bor te spyod par gshegs/de nas lho phyogs kyi yul zhig tu phebs pa'i sgo drung zhig tu skye bo gcig gis khrus chu dor ba'i thegs ma slob dpon zhabs la reg pas lcags bsregs la phog nga/ ltar khol bar ya mtshan du gyur/ nam zhig na mu stegs pa'i ston pa shang ka ra dī ba zhes pa des kha ti thi da ra'i rgyal po'i drung du lhags te/ ngas nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang rtsod cing rdzu 'phrul 'gran par byas te su pham pa de cig shos kyi bstan par 'jug cing de'i chos dang gtsug lag khang thams cad mer sreg par byed pas khyod kyis dpang po mdzad du gsol/de bzhin rgyal pos pho nya bkye ste nang pa rnams bsdus nas don de bsnyad pa na / sus kyang khas len ma nus pas rgyal sngo/ mya ngan du gyur pa na bran mo ka tsa ma has sngar mthong ba de zhus pas de lta bu sems dpa' chen po de ga na 'dug kyang chol cig ces bskul ba ltar phyogs kun btsal bas shing sdong gcig gi drung na sprang wa'i chul 'dzin te bzhugs pa mthong nas zhus pa na/'o na chu bum pa gang / ras yug gnyis/ me rnams sta gon gyis gsungs/de nas skye bo'i tshogs mang po 'dus pa 'i dbus su khri bshams te/ rgyal po dang / g.yas g.yon du slob dpon dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa 'khor bcas 'khod nas rtsod pas phyir rgol de dag spobs pas lan med du mdzad/

rgyan drug mchosag gnyis sogs/ 181slar yang mu stegs pa rdzu 'phrul 'gran par tshad de/ des bar snang la dbang phyug chen wa'idakyil 'khor bris te shar sgo tsam zin pa na/ slob dpo na 'dis zad pa ra rlung gi ting 'dzin la snyom pri ra zhugs pas 'tshub ma chen po langs te rtswa dang shing grong khyer thams cad kyang 'gyel ba la thug /rgyal po dang btsun mo sogs tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyang bdas/ dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i mu stegs kyi ston pa yang 'thor rlung gis bdas pa'i/ khye'u bzhin du phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'khyer zhing mun pa chen por gyur to//yang smin mtshams nas 'od phyung ste rgyal po dang btsun mo la lam bstan nas mdun du bkus ste gos dang bral zhing rdul gyis g.yog pa la chus bkrus nas ras gsar pa g.yog /me la bsku sa te bde bar byas/ de nas mu stegs kyi lha khang rnams bzhigs/ mu stegs pa du ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug pas da lta'i bar du gnas/ der mu stegs pham pa'i yul zhes grags/ yang mtshan can gyi lta ba 'dzin pa lnga brgya 'cho ba chad pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis bza' btung blangs te byin nas bde ba la bkod pa dang / mu ges nyam thag pa'i sprang po/ stong tsam ltogs pas nyen te 'chi ba la thug pa na/ slob dpon 'dis 'cho ba sbyar zhing chos bstan te bde bar bkod pa dang / yang shar phyogs a ri bo sha na zhes bya ba'i rgyal thorware pho brang nye logs kyi bzhi mdor bzhugs pa na/ ma tsha la'i sanod pa zhes pa 'tsho ba ma phyi pri sa gzhan gyi rdzas 'jogs ring / snying rje med nga/ mi bsrun pa mang du gyonas shing /yul gzhan nas kyang de dang mchungs pa du ma 'dus nga sa/ rgyal po de mi

182 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/dga' bar gyur te gnod byed 'di rnams 'byor pas mgu bar byas na ni rgyal srid thob pa don med la/ 'di tsho'i re ba bzhin ma bgyis na ni bdag gi lus sems gnyis ka 'jig par garo/na mi zacod snyam nas mya ngan gyis non pa na/ slob dpon 'dis bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes te/ gnod byed de dag zil gyis mnan te rgyal 'bangs 'kho ra bcas bde bar bkod pa dang / gzhan yang 'khrugs pa chen 1tsware 'thab zlar zhugs nas rdzu 'phrul gyis bsdums pa so/gas sngag mtshar can gyi mdzad pa'i gtam bdun zhes pa'ang yod do//

pon7jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha༄zhu / /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha ni rgya gar skad la dī paṃ ka ra shri dz+nyā na zhes pa bsgyur na dpal mar me mdzad ye shes zhes pa ste 'di nyid rgyal gar shar phyogs za thodar ram baṃ gā 'a ra yab rgyal po dge ba'i dang la dang /yum dpal snu/ 'od zer can gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku bltams/ zla ba'i snying nge zhes mtshan gsol/ sazhon nu'i dus mnal zhing bzhugs pa na grethodang gseb nas tsheg sgra 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung ba na/ yab ༷/ma 'khor bcas 'jigs shing skrag /rgyal sras gachodan nus ni dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston/ der yab yum sogs kyi mthong snang la gikhral sngon po yid 'ong zhig babs la/ gzhon nur rje btsun khyodal mas zhal bstan te gsung gi snang ba stsal/de nas bzung bya ba gal che ba thams cad rje btsun sbru/la mar zhus nas mdzad/ 'khrungs nas lo gcig dang zla drug sku nga ba na/ thi kra ma shī la pu ri zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang yod pa der rin po che'i cing rta'i nang

184 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gdan drangs te gshegs pa na/ skye bo thams cad 'dus nas 'khrungs pa'i tshe lhas mchod pa byed pa'i rgyal sras de da gdod mthong ngo zhes rgyal bu nyid la blta ba na/ rgyal sras 'dis yab yum gnyis la skye bo 'di dag su yin zhes dris pa na yab yum gnyis kyis khyod kyi 'bangs 'khor yin no zhes gsol ba na/ 'di dag bdag bzhin pha ma phun tshogs shing / /rgyal srid mnga' thang bsku/da nams 'bar ba yi/ /mi dbang sras kyi thu bor rab bskrun te / / thams cad dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar shog /ces smon par mdzad/de nas gtsug lag khang du phebs pa na yab yum sogs kyis tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang longs spu+od phun sum tshogs pa dang phyi ma ngan 'gror mi lhung bar bde 'gror skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ rgyal srid 'dis ni/ bdag ni dal 'byor mi dbang lus thob cing / /skyon med dbang pos dkon mchog gsum mthong zhing / /rtag tu gus pas dato/na mchog spyi bor blangs/ /de ring 'di nas skyabs gnas mdzad du gsol/ /nam yang khyim pa'i chos kyis ma bcings par/ /dge 'dun dbus su chos 'byor thob pa dang / /nga rgyal med par dkon mchog mchod byed cing / /skye bo kun la snying rje blta bar shog /ces thugs smon mdzad/ jo bo rjes chos gsungs pa'i thog mar 'di yin/de nas nar son pa na yab ༷/ma 'bangs dang bcas pas khyim du bzhugs na ci ma rung snyam du glu gar dang rtsed mo sna tshogs sbyar zhing / rgyal thod khag gi bu mo du ma khab tu bzhes pa'i grabs bshoms pa na rje btsun sgrol

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 185mas/ lha cig ma chags ma chags skal ba can/ /'dam bu'i tshal du glang chen bying ba ltar/ /'dod pa'i 'dam 'dir dpa' bo khyod bying na/ /tshul khrims gos can bsnubs par mi 'gyur ram/ /skye ba lnga brgya lnga bcu mganyis su / / paṇa chen dge slong gtsang ma'i lus brgyud nas/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'jug pa ltar/ /khyod ni tshe 'dir rab tu 'byung 'gyur lags/ /zhes rgyal srid la ma chags par cho)sa mdzad dgos par bskul ma btang / der rig gnas che chung mtha' dag la'ang sbyangs te mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/dgung grangs bathe lngar phebs pa'i tshe rigs thigs tshar gcig gsan nas ṇ+ḍi rol pa'i rtog ge mkhas par grags pa zhig dang ce da pas de pham par mdzad/ de nas gzhon nus da ni sa lam mthar phyin pa zhig byed pa la bshes gnyen dam pa zhig bsten dgos dgongs pa na pho brang dang thag nye bar dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal bzhugs pa lnga sa nas/ ri brag ba〉war du 'gro zhes bsnyad btagasanas rta pa sum brgya tsam dang bcas dze tu ri'i drung du phebs nas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed zhus/ rjes su 'dzin dgos zhus pa na/ nā lan+dhar bla ma byang chub bzang gro'idrung du song zhes lung bstan/de nas rgyal bu dmag dang bcas nā laster phebs nas bla ma byang chub bzang po'i drung du sems bskyed zhus/ des kyang nā lan+d+rara'i byang phyogs na che'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i rgyal sras rigs pa'i khu byug bzhugs pas de'i spyan sngar songs zhes btang ba ltar phebs nas gasku la ba btabs pas/lta ba'i man ngag zhib par zhus/ de'i lung bstan ltar bla ma a wa dhu ti

186 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/pa'i drung du phebs nas rjes su 'dzin par zhu zhus pa na/ bla ma a wa dhu ti pas chodas rnam dag byed par rgyal srid spangs dgos pas lan cig phar songs la rgyal srid blos thongs la de nas chur shog ces lung bstan/ de nas rgyal srid spangs nas bla ma a wa dhu ci pri 'i zhabs la gtugs/ a wa ju ti pas lung bstan nas ri nas ngo 'i gtsus lag khang kyi rdo rje'i zhal gzigs pa'i bla ma ra hū gup+ta las dbang yongs rdzogs zhus shing gsang mtshan ye shes gsang ba'i rdo rje zhes gsol/de nas lo bdun ring bla ma a wa ju ti pa dang bla mo du ma'i drung du gsang sngags la sbyangs pas/ sngags la nga mkhas/ sa snyam du dgangs pa na mnal lam du ḍa ki ma rnams kyis sngags kyi glegs bam sngar mthong ma myong ba mang po bstan nas thugs rgyal bcag /de ltar dgung lo nyer gcig nas nyer dgu'i bar du rgyud sde sbyangs shing nyams su bzhes pas lhag pa'i lha mang pos 'al gzigs/ ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes rgya chen po thob/ da tshe 'dir brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas mchog bi dngos grub lnga/ba pa zhis byed snyam du dgongs nga na / nub gcig rmi lam du dpal te ru ka nam mkhar byon mas/ rigs/ kyi bu ardza ju ti'i spyod pas gar yang mi phyin gyis khyod rab tu byung na dus phyis gdul bya mang po 'ong bang 'dus go zhes lung bstan/yang nub gcig rmi lam du/ ston pa shākya thub pa dge 'dun mang wa'i 'khor dang bcas nas gdugs tshod gsol gyin 'dug /de'i gral 'bas na jo bo nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis jo bor

jo bo rje dpal ldan a thi sha 187gzigs nas mi ma gi ci la chags nas rab tu mi byung / zhes gsungs pri zhis rmis pa na nges par rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam du dathodangs nas ma ti rtsi ha ra'i gtsug lag khang du phal chen sde nga/'i nang nas 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde pa slob dasngo na sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bka' brgyud gnas brtan sbyor lam pa shī la rak+ṣi ta zhes pa'i drung du rab tu byung / mchan dī paṃ/ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na zhes btags/de nas phar phyin theg pa'i sde snod gsum gar zhib tu sbyangs bing /khyad par bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta'i spyan sngar bstan bcos bye brag bshad mdzod chen sngo 'es bam sngo brgyad brgya tsam sku/da dz+ra 'e bstan bcos chen ngo de lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du mtha' chod par sbyangs pas/ sde pa bco brgyad po so so'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad ma 'dres par mkhyen nas sdo nga/ thams cad kyi gcug rgyan du gyur/ da ni myur du 'tshang rgya ba la lam gang zhis myur snyam pa na/bla ma rā hu las masngo na shes kyis mkhyen te thobs med du byon nas yi dam gyi lha zhal mthong ba dang / dkyil 'bor gyi lha tshogs mngon du gyur pa dang /thun mong bi dngos grub mang po thob pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ri brgyud tsam yod pas bar yang mi phyin/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyongs/thugs rje chen po sling rje'i lha yin pas yi dam du bzung / 'khor ba ma stong bar sems can gyi snga na byed par dam 'chos shig gsungs/yang rdor gdan gyi khor sar basmor ba mdzad tshe lnger bzo bonyis kyis dri lan mjad pa dang / rdor sadan gyi lho phyogs kyi nam mkhar mi'i

188 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/lus las 'das pa'i bu mo ga nyes gcis la dri ba 'e tshul du myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas chos gang la bslab par bya zhes zer bar gcig shos des byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o zhes sems sbyong li sgor gsung bzhin 'dug par jo bos bsle+or ba 'phro bcad nas gsan nga sa thugs/ su chud/ klu sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i rdo rur bzhugs stabs/ bud med rban gzhon yonyes 'dug nga/sa gzhon nga/ der rban pri/ des myur du 'chang rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems sbyong gsungs pa dang / yang rirdor gdan gyi gan d+dho lar bskor ba mdzad pa'i tshe bya 'dab 'og na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhig bzhugs pa'i zhal nas/ te bha dan+da/ myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi se/mas sbyongs gsungs /yang rdo ru'i khung bu la bsgor ba mngo da nga zhi'i tshe/ ba so'i rgyal ba shākya thub nga gcig 'dus pa des dzo shi/ myur du 'chang rgya bar 'dod na byang chub kyi sems kyi man ngag yongs rdzogs su la 44da snyam nas dpyad pa na dus de'i che bla ma gser gling nga/ byang chub kyi se mas kyi bdag por grags pas gser gling du 'byon bzhed nas tshong nga/ ram rgyus can dang bcas rgya mchor gyu ga zengs thog zla ba bcu gsum ring byon/ de'i che bdud kyis ma bag da nas mi mthun po'e rlung btang stse gru bozangs lam log nga ra bsgyur ba dang chu srin nya mis chen po gru gzings kyi ma/dun bkas pa dang nam mkha' nas/ thog babs pa sosas sarbod chabs chen ngo byas nga/ na nga/wī ta sa'i snying 2 du/sa jo bo rjer thugs dam bskul nga/sa/ jo bos saphrin rje sathed dmar

jo bo rje dpal ldan a nyi sha 189gyi sgo nas btul/ gser gling gi sne zin ma thag bla ma gser gling pa'i hrī ba ma bsam btan pa 'ga' shas bzhugs pa dang mjal/ der zhag bcu'i ring dpon slob tshang ma sku ngal bsos pa dang de dag la bla ma gser gling pa'i mjad rnam dri gtugs mdzad/ bsam gtan pa de chosas kyang lnga ྅rware slob ma rnams la jo bo rje'i mdzad rnam zhib dris byas pas yid ches kyi dad pa/ skyes nas bsam gtan nga de dag gis bla ma gser gling par zhus ming / de nas jo bo rje dpri+o na slob rnams bla ma gser gling pa'i pho brang dang nye bar phebs pa/ na dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga'i sne bla ma bser gling pas drangs nas dge tshul dang bcas rab byung lnga brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa bdun gyis bsu ba mdzad/de nas jo bo rje dang paṇ+ḍi ta sa snying sosas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lngas jo bo'i rjes la bar du mi re 'ong tsam du ma 'byur ba bar ma chad par gser gling pa'i sar phebs nas/ jo sngo rjes rin sngo che'i bum pa nang na dngos po ji yod phyi nas gsal ba'i nang gser/ dngul/ mu tig /byu ru/ be+eḍūr+yas bkang ba bla ma gser gling pa'i phyag tu phul/ jo tho'i slob ma sa'i snying po la sku gas pa rnams kyis kyang gser zho re phyag rten du phul te/ byang chub kyi sems sbyongs kyi man ngag zhus pas/ 'o/ bcu gnyis ring blo sbyong bi man ngag rnams gsan/ de nas sdug ྅pe rje'ang thugs tshim nas rgya gar du phebs khar bla ma gser gling pas thub dbang bi gser sku zhig yod pa de jo bo rjer gnang nas bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlabs/ de nas jo bo rje rdor

190 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gdan du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ lho phyogs nas mu stegs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta gdugs bcu gsum phub pa gcig byung ba des rtsod pa byed dgos zer nas rgyal po dpang du btsugs te rtsod pa mdzad de tshar bcad pas gdugs de dag jo bor phul/ slob ma byas nas phyi 1ril pa mang sngo nang pa'i bstan par bcug /yang sang phod lo dus su mu stegs pa gdugs brgyad phub pa gcig byung ba'ang sngar bzhin tshar bcad do//yang de'i sang phod mu stegs pa gdugs lnga phub pa sgra tshad la shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung nas/ snga ma ltar rtsod pas thog mar paṇ+ḍi ta sum cu tsam gyis go /de nas bco lnga tsam gyis go /de nas phra bar gyur nas bcu tsam gyis go /de nas lnga tsam gyis go /de nas kho rang gnyis las gzhan gyis go ma thub/ der mu stegs pa des sgra'i tshigs bcad gcig gi don dris pas sdur bos ma dgongs pa na chab gsang la phebs khul gyis nang du phebs nas cadal mar maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab pas/ thugs la wam gyis byung nas lan btab pas de tshar bcad/ slob mar khas blangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan par btsud/ de nas rgyal po ma dā pa la'i ring la jo bo rje thi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad/ de nas jo bo rje'i thugs bskyed dang /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes bod du bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i dus la bab bo//

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 191bod du bstan pa dar bar mdzad tshul ni/mnga' ris chodas rgyal ye shes 'od kyis dka' spyad du mas mnga' ris kyi lho gsal mang sngo rgya gar du brdzangs/ seskrita'i skad bslabs nas mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa bsgyur du bcug /'o/ chen rin bzang dang 'e/gas she byung / lha bla mas sbyin bdag mdzad de mtho lding dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/sngon glang dar gyi bstan pa bsnubs nas lo bdun cu tsam gyi ring bod du rab byung gcig kyang med pa na mnga' ris cesas rgyal mchod sku/na 11gas kyi mthus dge 'dun gyi sde rgya cher 'phel/ca/na kyang 'dul bar snu sa lho sa gsang sngags khyad du gasku da/ sngags la mo sa blo sa 'dul ba khyad du gasku da/ phal cher grub mtha'i kha 'dzin tsam las theg chen lam gyi lus sku/ngas swā gas lta chodag /spo/ ba chags pa tsam yang dkon/ rgya gar nas gser 'asnural ba mang 10 zhig cadad du sku nga nas sngags la bsnyad btags pa'i rtsing spyod dang / ngan sngags mang pos bod pa rnams bslu ba na/ lha bla mas thugs kyis ma bzod par rgya bsnyu na 'grus seng ge sku gas rgya gar du brdzangs nas chos bsgyur thub pa zhig dang / lhag par paṇ+ḍi ta thugs rgyud 'aX ngas pa bstan par phan thogs nges rig gdan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' phab ste gser phon chen bskur/ de chos kyang brtags skabs jo bo rje las lhag pa gzhan ma rnyed/ 'on kyang gdan 'dren ma thub par lo tsā ba dpon slob rnams tshur log ste/ mnga' ris chos rgyal khu dbon la

192 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa na ye thes 'od kyis da dung gser phon che btsal nas jo bo rje gdan 'dren pa dang / bstan nga rnam das cig tshugs dgos dasongs nas bser 'tshol du byon pas bar log thi rgyal pos lda bla ma ye shes 'od paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren phyir gser 'chodal bar ris nas 'di'i pha mes rnams kyis sngon yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas 'dug /'di ma bzung na 'dis paṇ+ḍi ta gdan drangs nas bstan pa dar bar byed 'ongs pa sa/ bzung la btson khung duchug cis zer nas ye shes/ 'od bzung nas btson du bcugade byang chub 'od kyis lnga sa nas rta pa brgya byas te khu bo bzlog tu phyin pas/ gar 64ga gi rgyal re/ kha tshan ches nas ma bzlog /der dmag rgyag na skye 'gro ma nga po zhis srog chad par snang ba dang / nga rang la yang bar chad 'byung na jo bo sadan mi drongs pas thabs mkhas bya dasongs nas blus pa dang khos khyod paṇ+ḍi ta sadan 'dren pa'i 'aho/ bsna la la nga'i 'og tu zhusas/yang na gser rgyal po/ dang mnyam pa gcig khyer shog zer/ de nas gser srang brgya tham pa khyer te rgyal po blus kyang ho sa ma nyan/ de nas rgyal po/ rang bi lus dang mnyam pa gcig khyer nas blus kyang ma nyan/ der ye thes 'od bzhugs sa'i sgo drung der phyin nas bos te/ bka' drin chen po / sngon gyi las thog tu bab pa yin pa/sa khor dmag brgyab na ni mi 'os/ sdis can bo'i codag tu zhugs pri las byed chos ldan gyi don du gathegs nga/ drags snyam nas/ gso/ra shi+ong kyi ne+e sa dang mnyam pa'i gser byung yang bos ma nyan/da khod kyi dbu tsam zhig rnyed nga/ dang blur 'ong rgi /depa'i bar du las la sem/sa

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 193pa dang dkon masnu ga la sasol 'debs/ snying chen po brang 'og tu bcug pa'i bsod nams mjad ngasos pa yin zhes gsol ba dang / khu bos bzhad gad mdzad nas/ khyod la'ang gces phrul snum zan ma'i bag cig yod/ dka' spyad mi nus snyam yang nga bi yang pha mes kyi srol stu da kyis skyodang bar snang / ༷ da kyi de go ba che/ nga des chog /nga da lam ma shi na yang lo bcu las med/ da lan chos kyi sngo na du bi na legs pas gar so/ga 'dir gser se ba ra tig gcig kyang ma ster/ saser thams cad rgya gar du khyer nas jo bo gdan ci 'brongs gyis/ pa wī ta'i slan du yang / ngas khyed dang bstan pa'i snga na du lus srog sar los rgyal ngo/ra btang yod pa sa rjes 'odzin dang / nga'i bsam don bod du bstan pa dar bar byed pa yin nga sa de khu+o na bzhin mdzad pa/ dang / skye ba 'di'i 'os rol du'ang khred dang mjal bar mdzod cis ces nga'i 'phrin mdzod cig da ni nga blos 10ngas la bstan nga ra sdu/mas shig sasungs/de nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis mo rtsis brtas pa'i lung bstan ltar nas tsho lo tsā ba bos te khyed jo to spyan 'dren par rgya bar du 'byon dbos 'es gser phon che ba dang / g.yog ji dgyo+os gtong / chod bo la 'di sked zhus cig /sngo na chos rgyal rnams kyis rgyal bstan dar spel mdzad rkong glang dar gyis/ bsnubs/ de nas nged kyi yab mes rnams kyis rgyal bstan slar btsugs kyang nyams len du 'khrer r+shas pri dkon 'ing / rtsing spyod kyis bstan nga ra grenod/ nged kyi khu bo ye shes 'od kyis chul de ma bzod nas byed gyodan 'dren nga 'i gser 'chol du byon nga sa sar los rgyal ngo sa bkrongs
