194 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ri so/gas kyi gtam rnams jo wali snyan lam du thongs chis /nga'i khu bo snying tre can nge 'orme brgyal/ ngas khu bo de bzhag nas 'ong phod pa/ ngas sgo'i gseng nas blta sa pas sku ni dar gyis bcings/ gsung mdangs ni shor/ sku lus dung ba tsam du song yang / bod kyi bstan 'gro dang / jo bo 'ba' zhig thugs la se mas/ nged bod mtha' 'khob kyi skye wa'i snying stobs kyang de 'dra na/ khyed dze+e bas gnas thugs rje can rnams jije tsug la sku nga 'es zhus shig ces mngags/nas cho lo tsā ba dasngo na sasku ga rgya gar du brdzangs/nas chod rgya gar du byon pa'i lam bar bar chad mang sngo byung ba spyan ras gzigs kyi spru la pa sna ce/gas pas bsal te bi kra ma la shī lar slebs/rdor rgya brtson seng dang gros byas te jo bo gdan 'dren pa'i ngas bkod byas nga/'i re zhig jo bo mjal yang dka' ba byung / de nas gsang ba'i thog nas ñca brtson seng sis nas tsho jo bo'i gzim khang du khrid/ ma/ṇ+ḍal phru sang pa gcis steng gse ra ling ba de ba'as /sil ma tshom bur bkod nas jo bor phul te/ rgya brtson seng bis sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams gtam btang ste da res kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'di mgon po khyed spyan 'dren du 'ong gda' bas/ na 4snang ske da mi gsung ba bod la thugs rjes gzigs zhus pas/ jo tho'i zhal nas drang kyi rgyal sngo dang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang / bla chen dri — dang bcas pri byang chub sems/ dpa'i rnam 'phrul yin/ de min na bstan ji ru'i me/ ro bslang tu mi zhus/ ngas byang chub sem/sa dpa'i bka' bcag tu m+mu rung / rgyal/ po der ngo yang gnong / mi nor mang po chud zos la song /

jo bo rje dpal ldan a thi ba 195bod rnams snying rje ba'ang 'dug ste/ nga na so rgas/ lde mig mang po'ang 'dzin/ bya ba'i 'phro mang po sku da/ codan kyang ngas brtag pa gcig bya yi/re zhis gser nyar tshags gyis gsungs/de nas jo dus spyan ras gzigs dang khyodal mar gsol ba btab nas/ ngas bod du phyin na bstan 'gror phan lnga gas min rgyal ngo'i thugs dbo ngas rdzogs min/ rang la bar chad 'gyur min gsum ga1/la ba btab pas de'i nub mo/ mnal lam na/ gnas 'di 'dra zhig na nang pa 'i lha khang chung ngu zhig sku da pa der song la rnal 'byor ma zhig 'ong bas der dris gsung ba smas/ nangs par jo thodas me tog snyim nga gang bsnams nas lha khang der phebs pa na rnal 'byor ba ral pa sa la 'am me ba zhig byung / der dris pas cadad du byon na phan thogs 'ong / khyad parakusdu pa si ka gcig la brten nas phan thogs codang gsungs/ da dung ྅nir sadan du mchod chen byas nas gasku/la ba gdab dgos snyam nas chas pa na mkhan po dz+nyā na shrī mi tras 'bo/na bu sbar gang bskur nas sngo ra gdan na rgan mo ral pa se sha re ba gcig yod/ der phul gsung skad/de na rdor gdan du byon tsa na rgan mo des/ nga la bskur ba'i 'gron bu sprod dang gsungs/ de la yid kyis phyas dang dri ba mdzad pas kyang gong dang mthun pa byung / lus srog la bar chad mi 'gyur ram zhus pas thodad du ma byon na dgung lo dgu bcu go gnyis dang / phebs na bdun cu rtsa gsum las mi thub gsungs/ chod bo'i dathodangs par bod la phan thogs na tshe la mi blta snyam pa'i thugs stobs skyes/ de nas jo tho je la dge 'dun gyi sde rnams

196 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/dang / sbyin bdag rnams kyis bod du byon na rgya gar chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams nga/ra 'gyur zhes bkag nas 'drodan mi 'jug par dzab dus thabs mkhas kyis bod du 'byon pri 'i 'phros med par rdo rje gdan 14gas gnas chen rnams su mchod pa rgya che ba re bgyid pa yin 'es sasungs nas phar phebs tshur phebs mdzad/'jam dang la the rje sogs sku rten dang gsung rten mang du yod pa rnams 'brom gyi sprul pa tshong pa'i rnam can zhig gis sus kyang ma tshor bar gdan drangs pa sogs rim gyis jo bo rjes bal yul du phebs/ de'i rgyal po grags pa mtha' yas sogs dad ldan thams cad kyis zhus nas der so/ gcis bzhugs/ thang r+bhe ha ra'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te dge 'dun gyi sde btsug /de nas jo tho je dpon slob rnams kyis bal pri+o rdzong du phebs pa na/ lha btsun pas bas mar btang bshin rta pa sum brgya tsam lhunang ste gos rgyan thams cad dkar po 'ba' zhig byas/ blon po chen po lha'i dbang phyug dang lha'i blo gros dang lha'i shes rab dang / lha'i srid 'dzin zhes bya ba ba'i la dang 'a bo dar mdung dkar sngo lnga gas pa bcu drug this bsor/ gzhan thams cad la yang ba dan chung ngu re dang / chu dar gyi gdugs nyi shu dang / spa3 dang gling bu'i sgra snyan 'khrol zhing dpon gasku ga thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro byed pa dang / bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar 'gyur ro bya ba'i kha brda bzang po byed/ thams cad kyang rta las mi babs par gros sgor mor byas te/ dbus sus ti ya dpon ga yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnam/sa bcug nas mi rta thams cad kyi mgre+o bo nang du rug gis bstan/ blon ngo chen ngo ba'i dbas su 'ongs/ sngon chos rgyal

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 197khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhan po bo dhi satwa spyan drangs pa'i drung du blon po rig pa can rnams kyis skor mo'i glu blangs pa ltar blon po rnams kyis glu blangs pa ni ca lo zhes bya ba grags stong snyan pa'i glung dbyangs lo/ /zhes sogs bkra zhis pa'i glu dbyangs dang bcas spyan drangs/nag tsho lo tsā ba la sogs pa rab tu byung ba'i rta nga/ sum cu rtsa lngas bskor ba'i dbus na chibs cang shes mthong smon ngang pa'i steng na jo bo rje khru gang can gyis sga la ma reg par sku'i dkyil 'khor mdzes zhing blta na sdus pa lha mi yongs kyis mchod gnas de'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa/soskyo ta'i gsung gis/ e ma then/ a ti a ti/ pha la pha la/ pha la ho zhes sogs siskyi ta'i skad du bkra yis mang du brjod par mjad cing rim gyis phebs/ sangs rin po cher 'bas 'khor dang bcas pa gso sbyong mdzad pa'i ghan ṇ+ḍi'i sgra gsan zhing gnas brtan chen po dang dngos su mjal nas bka' babo sa mdzad/ mtsho ma pham gyi 'gram du chab gtor mdzad pa'i tshe thugs rje chen wa'i 'al gzigs jing klu rnams kyis mchod pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang du mchis/ de nas rim gyis gu be mtho lding du phebs nye ba na nag tshos lha bla ma byang chub 'od la 'phrin yig phul bas lha btsun chen po yin tu dgyes nas/ ngas dad gas kyis rgyun du gsol ba btab nas yun ring song ste da lha cig dang mjal ba yin/ mdang rmi lam na nub phyogs nas nyi ma'i dkyi+ol 'khor chen po gcig dang / shar phyogs nas zla ba'i dkyil 'bor nya sang ba zhis yar/ de bonyis ldan cis tu 'tshogs

198 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ma thag sprin dang khu rdul thams cad rang sar dengs/ skar tshogs thams cad nam gung bzhin khra mnyam par nyi zla gnyis la 'dud kyin yod pa smas/zla ba de nga yin nam snyam yang shar phyogs ma gi nas byung ba su yin mi shes/gang ltar rmi ltas kyang shin tu bzang gsungs/de nas jo bo rje gzhis byes kyi rta pa lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor ba'i dbus na chibs mthong smodan rlung gathodag la phru gang tsam ma reg par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar lham pa zhwa shin tu mdzes pa gsol ba dpon slob sum cu so bzhi po thams cad lta spyod dang cha lugs mtshungs kyang / jo bo'i na bza' de jo cho sa ma snum zhing dri zhim la mdangs chags pa/ sku brjid chags pa drang zhing mdzes la skabs phyed pa sogs blta bas ngom pa med pa de skye bo'i mārgags kyis mjal ma thag tu skyabs su mchirtson zhes lan gsum gsum thams cad kha nas dbang med du byung zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /nged cag bod kyi sems can las ngan can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs shig /khyod kyi ༷ gas su dka' las byed pa'i lha khu dbon shin tu bka' drin che ba 'dug /bod kyi mi nor thams cad kyang 'gyod pa med/ khyed gdan 'dren pa la dka' ngal 'ong ba 'o/sa bden/ da ni skal ba bzang ngo zhes thams cad dad pas 'ur ba dang jo bo rje yang shin tu mnyes nas bod kyi skye bo rnams la gzigs shing byin rlabs mdzad/ lha bla ma'i a ṇi lha cig chos 'bum gyis kyang jo bo'i zhal mjal nas thal mo sbyar te mkhas pa 'di'i phyogs su nga'i ming po gser gyi ri rab 'dra ba gcig gshegs te/ nga sems mi khral mya mi ngan/

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 199ming po de'i srog dang paṇ+ḍi ta 'di brjes pa yin te brje rin chog /bal po na ha su/ mnga' ris na rin bzang sogs nga che zer ba rnams la lnga ma pa yin zer nas lha bla ma'i mya ngan ri tsam sku da pa sangs/ mgul g.yu gser srang lnga bcu re ba zhig jo bo la phul/de nas jo bo rje mtho lding gser gyi lha khang du phebs shing byang chub cadad kyis phebs rdo na rgya cher mdzad/ lo chen rin bzang gis kyang rang gnas gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs/ dbu ma snang ba dang lhag par bde mchog gi dbang dang rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs sdu/gas cesas mtha' yas pa gsan/nyams rtogs bzang po skyes/ dngos po ci yod jo bor phul/ jo bos nga'i 'o/ tsā la 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ lo tsā bas dbu bstan te/ mgo dkar po 'di ltar song bas sgrub pa zhig byed par zhus pas/ ka ya rin bzang khyod sgrub pa gsha' ma byed na/ bya ba ngan pas ma g.yeng bar ma17da cig gsungs pa'i zhal gdams thugs la bzhag nas/ sgrub khang gi sgor lcags gzer btab/ sgo'i ya them la gnas 'dir tha mal pa'i rtog pa skyes na chos skyodang rnams kyis margo bo khos zer ba bris nas lo bcu'i ring sgrub pa mdzad pas/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs/de nas byang chub so/da kyis jo ngo la yab mes chodas rgyal rnams kyis bstan pa btsugs kyang chal cesal du sku/nga tshul sdu/gas mchi ma 'khrug bzhin zhib zhus dang bcas/ da ni jo bo thugs rje can khyod kyis bod kyi gdul bya dmu lha da can la snu sa zab zab mo dang mtshar mtshar mo mi

200 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/'tshal/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi sand bsdus pa/ nyams su blang bde ba bod spyi la phan pa zhig thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas jo ngo shin tu dgyes nas/ byang chub lam sgron mdzad/de nas jorwa pe dbus gtsang du phebs bzhed kyang / rgya gar nas 'byon dus thi kra ma la shī la'i gnas brtan gyis nag sto lo tsā bar sdur ྅ bod nas 'i/ gsum nas tshur ma bskyal na dam tshig nyams sku/ zhes dam tshig la bkar te nag tshos khas len byed dgos byung ba bzhin des rgya gar du phyir 'aX na par bskul/ jo bos kyang pu hreng bar phebs/ sgrol mas dge bsnyen zhig la brten nas bstan pa la phan codings zhes yang yang gsungs shing / de skabs kyang dge bsnyen myur du 'ong 'es lung bstan pas jo bos nyin ltar bya ra mdzad cing / nga'i u pa si ka da dung ma byung tā res rdzun ni cang gsung ngam zhes gsungs skad/nyin gcig jo ༷ye sbyin bdag cig gis gdan drangs pa'i shul du 'brom ston pa jo bo'i gzim khung du phebs pa na/ jo bo da lta phebs yong zhes brjod kyang / 'brom gyis ngas dbe ba'i bshes gnyen mjal bar skad cig snga phyi gnyis snga ma 'dam pas sgug mi lta/ma zhes phebs pas srang bar zhig tu mjal/ de nyin sbyin bdag la nga'i u pa si kya'i skal ba dbenas zhes mar zan bsnams sku/da pa de gnang / 'alnge/ma gyis zan bzhes/ mar gyis mar me mtshan thub cig bzos nas jo bo'i dbu sngas su phul/ de nas bzung sku tshe hril ra jo jo'i dbu sngas su mtshan me chad med du phul/ jo bas 'phral mar 'brom la dbang bskur nas sras kyi thu bor bzung / de nas pu hreng nas rim

jo bo rje dpal ྅ na a ti ya ཿ 01gyis mang yul skyid grong du phebs/ de'i tshe jo bo'i thugs bskyed dang /bod kyi bsku da nams kyis bal po rdzong du dmag zing this lam 'gas nas skyid grong rang byung 'phabs nga pa'i lha khang du gdul bya du mar chos gsungs bzhin lo gcig bzhugs/ der phyas mjub kyis ma ṇ+ḍi 'bri bar mdzad pa ma ṇi la kha zhes grags shing / deng sang der skyid grong bsam btan gling chags yod/'brom rin ngo/ ches thabs mkhas kyis bod du sku gsung thugs rten dang / dge 'dun stong phrag mang po yod tshul sogs zhus pri sa jo bo bod du 'byon ba'ed pa na 'brom gyis dbus phyogs su rjog legs nga/'i thes rab dang /khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung sogs mang du bzhugs yod kyang zhu yis ka ba shākya dbang phyug la btang nas bod kyi bla chen rnams kyis jo bo bdan 'dren pa ston dus tshun la 'byor bar mdzad dgos zhes zhu 'phrin phul ba dbe bar+shas ka bas bod kyi bla chen rnams la brda byas te thams cad phebs grabs byas pa na ko khu khyodan gyis nga sogs kho ngas su 'jog 'os pa min zhes sngon la phebs nga sa/ thams cad 'ur langs kyis 'phral du thon te phebs bsu la 'alnga/mas/de yang jab dus chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i gnas la chos 'khor zhes ming chags te/ deng sang yang grwa chodas 'khor dang / la ldab chos 'khor zhes ming du chasas/ de'i tshe nag tshos jo bo rgya gar la 'phral du spyan 'dren ni ma thub/bi kra ma la ni/ la'i gnas brtan gyi dam cirgag dran nas thugs khral mdzad pas/jo bo rjes lo tsā ba de tsam gyis se mas ngal mi dgre+os/ sgrub par mi nus nga/

202 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/la nyes pa med gsungs pa na/ lo tsā ba gting nas dga' zhing mgu ste 'o na jo bo bod dbus su 'drodan par zhu zhes gasku la ba btab/ de nas dbus gtsang gi bla chen mi chen rnams kyis bas ba slebs/ de'i tshe bod kyi bla ma chen po rnams kyi thodad kyi gzan 'khyor gyi chas bse theb dang / rta phying gyon rta bzang sngo la chibs nas 'ongs pa na lhur lnga sa gzigs ma thag /u pa si ka 'dre mang po slebs byung / ci yin zhes dbu dam gtums nas bzhugs/ de nas 'brom rin po ches bod kyi bla chen rnams la rab byung gi chas mdzad nas drodan dbo sa zhes zhus pa ltar phebs pa na jo bos kyang bzhengs te phyag lan mdzad/de nas rim gyis gtsang lhu gas la phebs che pal khud thang du lho brag mar pa lo tsā ba rgya gar du rting ma phebs pa dang mjal/ mar pas jo bo'i drung nas chos 'brel zhus/ jo bos nga'i lo tsā la 'gro gsungs pas/ da res cis kyang rgya gar du phyin chog pa dgos slar mjal chodag pa zhu zhes zhus/de nas rim gyis phebs te sa skya'i thad du phebs pa na sa skya la phyag mdzum gtad de gnas 'dir 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun 'byung zhes lung bstan/ der 'brog mi lo tsā bas 'bas la gtugs/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis phebs te snar thang gi thad du phebs pa na gnas 'dir 'phags pri 'i gnas brtan gyi sprul pa 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan/ de nas chogs 'dus su phebs te zhwa lu mthil gyi lha khang dang /khyad par ri sbug tu bzhugs nas chos mang du gsungs/ de nas myang stod

jo bo rje dpa la ldan a tri 8 203nyan tsher dbyar gnas mdzad/ yol cesas/ yol drang lha/nga / yol thog 'bebs gsum dang 'asos los kyang gnas der phebs nas jo bo'i zhabs la gtugs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyer dason pa bas kyang gnas der phebs/jo ngo bsten te rdzo bo'i mchod gnas mdzad/ dbyar gnas grol nas rong brgyud dbus su phebs ste gnas byang thang du phebs pa na lha sa'i thad kyi ri la phyag mdzub gtad nas pha gi na ci yod gsungs/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang yod zhus pas de'i thad 'ja'i gur gsum brtsegs 'dug /lha'i bu dang bu mo mang sngo sa mchodad pa byed kyi 'dug gsungs/ de nas bsam yas su phebs/ lha btsun bo dhi rā dzās 'bas tog mdzad/ bod kyi mi chen 'dus sa la chos rgya cher 35pa/bsam yas su job dus lha khang la thogs med du byon pa dang zhabs sa la gareg par bskor ba mdzad pa sogs rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod/ de nas khu ston gyis yar klungs su spyan drangs nas thang po cher ru khri bzang zer ba brtsigs pa'i ru brtsegs khang par bzhugs/ chos mang du gsungs/ khus zhabs donag bzang ba ma byung bas 'a1thum ston sogs dpon slob rnams bros te myang wa'i gru la zhugs pa na/ bu ston gyis rjes bsnyegs te a ti sha bzhugs zhes zhu ba byas kyang ma gsan par dbu zhwa byin rlabs kyi rten du 'phangs/ de nas 'on gyi lha khang ke rur zla ba gcig bzhugs/ de'i rtsig ngos la nyid kyi sku 'dra gcig 'bri bar mdzad/ de nas bsam yas su phebs nas pe har gling du bzhugs/ rgya dpe/ mang po gzigs pas shin tu dgyes te

204 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/sngon bod du bstan pa dar ba 'dra ba rgya gar du yang ma byung gsungs/ byang chub chen sngo mjal bas ma hā bo dhi dang khyad mi snang gsungs/ gnas dang gtsug lag khang la thugs shin tu dgyes/de nas bang lha na gyi bsu ba rta pa nyis brgya tsam slebs te dpon g.yog rnams rgod dkar la phebs/ rgya phibs su zla ba gcig bzhugs/de nas rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis lha sa 'phrul snang du spyan drangs nas bsu ba'i dus jo bo thugs rje chen pos mi ring skya bo zhig tu sprul nas mahwa paṇ+ḍi ta drodan pa legs/ rgyal bar gyur cig gsungs nas bzhud nga sa/ jo bos chibs las babs te rgyugs pas ma zin/ de ltar mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ khyed kyi mi ring skya bo de mthong ngam gsung /malnga nga lags zhus pas/ de nga'i yi dam thugs rje chen wa yin/ phyag bya bar 'awa da nas rgyugs pas ma zin gsungs/ 'khrul snang gi thugs rje chen po 'di las ngo mtshar ba che ba rnge da/ thugs rje chen po dngos yin gsungs/ jo bo shākya mu ni gzigs pas sprul pa'i sku dngos/ yin gsungs nas rgya gar gyi lha baX ba mkhas pa gcig la 'ari kho na 'dra ba zhig bzhengs shig ces ba'engs su bcusasrong btsan gyis gtsug las khang 'di lta bu ba'engs nga/'i lo rgyus yod nges dasongs pa'i tshe sprang mo smyon ma gcig gis gtsug lag khang gi lo rgyus 'tshal lo zer/ de rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor mar mkhren nas yid kyis phyag mchod byas nas cis kyang 'tshal gsungs pas/ 'o na ka ba bum

jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti ( 205pa can na 'dom phyed dang gsum gzhal ba'i sa na yod/ gzhan la ma smra zhig gsungs/ de jo bos rnyed pas gter srung gnyen po zhig 'dug pa na re/de ring ji tsam zin pa cig 'brir gnang bi zer bas/ rnal 'byor pa sogs ston pa bzhi gas bris pas lhag ma cung zad lus gsungs/ lha sar dgun gcig bzhugs/ der cugs khyad nga/ra can mang du byung / de'i dbyar rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis spyan drangs nas yer par bzhugs/ 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug gis 'phan sngo ra spyan drangs/ man pa spyil bur bzhugs/ chos mang du gsungs/ de nas yer par byon/ de'i dus su bang ste na gyi spyan 'dren byung ste phyir lam lda sa brgyud snye thang du phebs/ de'i tshe 'brom rin po ches lam gyi rim pa'i bka' gnas rnams nyin mtshan kun tu dpyad pa nar mar mjad/slar yang yer pa lha ri snying gro'i mgul du phebs nas// jo bo yab sras kyis lo gsum gyi ring la zab rgyas kyi lam gyi rim pri 'i gyenas rnams la brgal brtag gis mtha' gcod par mdzad/ bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi man ngag ches cher gsungs/ thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang gdam sa ngas rnams grenang / gsang phu ba rngogye legs pri 'i shes rab kyis chog du yab sras gnyis la maṇ+ḍal phul te yab sras gnyis sha'i gsang ba thun sma/nga min pa/ rnams ston par gsol ba btab nga/sa 'brom rin po che'i skyes rabs zab mo rnams jo bos gsungs/ 'brom rin sngo che nyid kyis bka' rgya shin tu dam pa sprul pre/'e glegs bam zhes deng sang bka' gdams glegs bam du grags si/ 'ode gsungs/ mi

206 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/rabs mang wa'i bar du chig brgyud kho na las rgya cher spel ba'i gnang ba ma thob/phyis su 'brom rin po che'i sprul pa 'brom kun ma ras bka' rgya bkrol te spel/de nasadapal snar thang gi chos sder rim gyis 'phel nas deng sang phyogs thams cad du khyab pa 'di byung ba yin no//yang dag lam bzang gsal mdzad bla ma dang //rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la//rnam dag dad pas lan brgyar phyag byas nas//spang blang rnam gzhag 'ga' tsam bsnyad par bya//— bslab par bya ba rnam grangs mang na yang //gnad la phan pa rang la rag las pas//bya ba gang la'ang las 'bras dpang bzhag nas//rnam dkar las lam dag la 'bad par bya//dal ba brgyad ldan sangs rgyas bstan dang phrad//mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dag dang mjal//da lan 'dra ba slan chad tshad dka' ba//yang yang bsam nas dal ba 'bras ldan 'tshal//

rje dpal ldan a nyi sha 107khas blangs bcas mtshams phra rags thams cad la//nan tan bsam pa thag pas 'bad byas na//sras bcas rgyal bas rab bsngags lam bzang yang //rang rang lag na gnas pas 'bad par 'tshal//zab rgyas man ngag mtha' yas mnyan na yang //kha bshad tsam la 'phyan na phan dka' bas//mtha' dag rang rang bsam pa dang sbyar nas//nan tan lag blangs bya ba man ngag gnad//snga char mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa btsal//slad nas zab rgyas gdams ngag tshang bar mnyan//tha mar gdams ngag mtha' dag nyams blangs na//sangs rgyas sar chas skal bzang ldan pa lags//bsam rgya ma mang gang brtsams pha mthar bskyal// skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la dad pa sbyangs//dkar nag las 'bras bsam nas spang blang bya //'bad pa 'bras dang bral la ngal ba spangs//

208 chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gzhan la bsam ngan 'tshang bas rang rang nyams//'chal gtam smra ba mang bas bya ba 'chag/nga rgyal chags sdang can la dgra ldang bas//rang rang gzhan la gang phan brtags nas bya//rgyal dang rgyal sras bcas pa thams cad kyang //lhag bsam rnam par dag pa las bltams pas//rtag par gzhan phan bsam pa sbyangs pa dang //mtha' 'bras yang dag lta bas rgyas gdab bya//sngar bsags las ngan mtha' dag 'bad pa brgyas//tho bshags na g.yang sa nyam nga dgag pa dang //rnam dkar gang byas ma rnams thams cad la//phan slad bsam pa thag pas mtshams sbyar bya//lugs zung sgrub tshul gzhung lugs nyung bsdus su//'grig 'grig tshig gi yir gyis 'di yis ni// legs nyes 'byed byed ye shes gter rnyed de//〉tebs sogs yongs sngo gas mgon po mchog thob sho/ //

dpar skrun smon tshigako༅༅/ /rnam cadal zhi ba'i rgya mtshor mo gcig tu/ /gcadal ba'i mtha' yas chodas tshul dal 'bab klung / /tshig gi zegs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma yongs 'khrud legs bshad bdud snyunga'adi/ /par du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung po'i mthus/ /yang dag spyodas kyi khyod mo rdo nga phrag brgya/ /gdangs te rgyud lnga 'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog/ces pa 'di yang deng dus yid srub kyis rgyud brlams pa'i kla gro'i sdig khyodad mi bzad pas gangs ljongs chos ldan gyi zhing du thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo'i snang ba ltar 'bar ba de ni ming gi lhag ma tsam du nyam nyes par byas/ phyo gas dang chu gas na rdul phran gyi mtsho na cha sogs gdug pa'i gasna da 'tshe gya gyu'i rjodar ba ni nyin re bzhin du dar ba so/gas sgo kun nas lnga bdo'i rgud tshogs mtsho ltar brdol ba 'di dag lhag med du zhi zhing / byang phyogs bod kha ba can du bstan pa'i me mo slar yang sngar bzhin gsos te rgya gar 'phags pa'i ljongs 'dir yang thub pa'i bzhed dgongs dri ma med pa dar rgyas su 'phel slad dang / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam 〈snan rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i ring lugs sgo kun nas rgyas pa sogs 'phral yun legs tshogs du ma'i ched du dmigs/ sbag sa nang bstan shes rig 'dzin skyong slob gnyer khang du/ nang bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab par du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i smon tshig tu 7shākya'i dge sbyong chos smra ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o//
